4.25.m:
However, let him go from Vaikuṇṭha back to the dwelling of Ambarīṣa;
let the sage break his fast there, to the great delight of the king.

4.25.s:
viprastasyātithirbhūtvā nirdoṣaṃ śaptumudyataḥ ..
sudarśanaṃ tu taṃ rakṣyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ hantumudyatam ..146..
4.25.d:
विप्रस्तस्यातिथिर्भूत्वा निर्दोषं शप्तुमुद्यतः ॥
सुदर्शनं तु तं रक्ष्यं ब्राह्मणं हन्तुमुद्यतम् ॥146॥
4.25.m:
Becoming his guest, the Brahmin was ready to curse that innocent man;
and Sudarśana was prepared to kill the Brahmin in order to protect that [king].

4.25.s:
pūrṇaṃ varṣamayaṃ bhīto bhramatyeva bhuvaṃ mudā ..
upavāsī sa rājendraḥ sastrīkaśca śucā'nvitaḥ ..147..
4.25.d:
पूर्णं वर्षमयं भीतो भ्रमत्येव भुवं मुदा ॥
उपवासी स राजेन्द्रः सस्त्रीकश्च शुचाऽन्वितः ॥147॥
4.25.m:
For a whole year, terrified, he has indeed wandered the earth [without rest], / while that king of kings, fasting along with his wife, is filled with sorrow.
Therefore, I too am fasting because of my devotee's fasting,

4.25.s:
tato'hamupavāsī ca bhaktopavāsakāraṇāt ..
stanāndhaṃ bālakaṃ dṛṣṭvā na bhuṅkte jananī yathā .. 148 ..
4.25.d:
ततोऽहमुपवासी च भक्तोपवासकारणात् ॥
स्तनान्धं बालकं दृष्ट्वा न भुङ्क्ते जननी यथा ॥ 148 ॥
4.25.m:
just as a mother does not eat on seeing her breast-fed child [hungry].
By my blessing, let the best of sages immediately become free from fever [and fear];

4.25.s:
mamāśiṣā muniśreṣṭhaḥ sadyo bhavatu vijvaraḥ ..
pathi tatrāsya hiṃsāṃ ca maccakraṃ na kariṣyati .. 149 ..
4.25.d:
ममाशिषा मुनिश्रेष्ठः सद्यो भवतु विज्वरः ॥
पथि तत्रास्य हिंसां च मच्चक्रं न करिष्यति ॥ 149 ॥
4.25.m:
on the road, and there, my discus will do him no harm.
Today, free from anxiety, I will certainly eat with pleasure;

4.25.s:
ahamevādya niścintaḥ sukhaṃ bhokṣyāmi niścitam ..
bhaktadattaṃ ca yadvastu prītyā kṛtvā sudhopamam ..4.25.150..
4.25.d:
अहमेवाद्य निश्चिन्तः सुखं भोक्ष्यामि निश्चितम् ॥
भक्तदत्तं च यद्वस्तु प्रीत्या कृत्वा सुधोपमम् ॥4.25.150॥
4.25.m:
making whatever thing is offered by a devotee with love equal to nectar.
Even an offering given by Lakṣmī I am not able to enjoy [alone];

4.25.s:
lakṣmīdattaṃ ca yaddravyaṃ na cāhaṃ bhoktumīśvaraḥ ..
vinā bhaktapradānena na tṛptiṃ dātumīśvaraḥ .. .. 151 ..
4.25.d:
लक्ष्मीदत्तं च यद्द्रव्यं न चाहं भोक्तुमीश्वरः ॥
विना भक्तप्रदानेन न तृप्तिं दातुमीश्वरः ॥ ॥ 151 ॥
4.25.m:
without the giving of a devotee, it is not able to bestow satisfaction.
O lord among sages, great in wisdom, go, dear child, to the abode of the king;

4.25.s:
he munīndra mahāprājña gaccha vatsa nṛpālayam ..
sarve devāśca devyaśca gacchantu munayo gṛham ..152..
4.25.d:
हे मुनीन्द्र महाप्राज्ञ गच्छ वत्स नृपालयम् ॥
सर्वे देवाश्च देव्यश्च गच्छन्तु मुनयो गृहम् ॥152॥
4.25.m:
and let all the gods, the goddesses, and the sages return home."
Having spoken thus, Śrī Hari quickly and joyfully went to his inner apartments.

4.25.s:
ityuktvā śrīharistūrṇaṃ yayau svāntaḥpuraṃ mudā ..
yayuḥ sarve mudā yuktāḥ praṇamya jagadīśvaram .. 153 ..
4.25.d:
इत्युक्त्वा श्रीहरिस्तूर्णं ययौ स्वान्तःपुरं मुदा ॥
ययुः सर्वे मुदा युक्ताः प्रणम्य जगदीश्वरम् ॥ 153 ॥
4.25.m:
Having spoken thus, Śrī Hari quickly went to his inner apartments with joy.
Filled with joy, having bowed to the Lord of the universe, they all departed.

4.25.s:
brāhmaṇaśca manoyāyī jagāma nṛpamandiram ..
sudarśanaṃ ca taccakraṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham .. 154 ..
4.25.d:
ब्राह्मणश्च मनोयायी जगाम नृपमन्दिरम् ॥
सुदर्शनं च तच्चक्रं सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभम् ॥ 154 ॥
4.25.m:
And the brāhmaṇa, travelling as swift as thought, went to the king's palace,
as did that Sudarśana discus, equal in brilliance to ten million suns.

4.25.s:
upoṣya vatsaraṃ rājā śuṣkakaṇṭhoṣṭhatālukaḥ ..
siṃhāsanasthaḥ purato dadarśa munipuṅgavam .. 155 ..
4.25.d:
उपोष्य वत्सरं राजा शुष्ककण्ठोष्ठतालुकः ॥
सिंहासनस्थः पुरतो ददर्श मुनिपुङ्गवम् ॥ 155 ॥
4.25.m:
Having fasted for a year, with his throat, lips, and palate dried up,
the king, seated on his throne, saw the foremost sage before him.

4.25.s:
utthāya saṃbhramātsadyaḥ praṇamya sādaraṃ mudā ..
bhojayitvā tu miṣṭānnaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bubhuje svayam .. 156 ..
4.25.d:
उत्थाय संभ्रमात्सद्यः प्रणम्य सादरं मुदा ॥
भोजयित्वा तु मिष्टान्नं ब्राह्मणं बुभुजे स्वयम् ॥ 156 ॥
4.25.m:
Rising up at once in agitation, having bowed with respect and joy,
he fed sweet food to the brāhmaṇa and then ate himself.

4.25.s:
bhuktvā tuṣṭo dvijaśreṣṭho yuyuje paramāśiṣam ..
jagāma svālayaṃ tūrṇaṃ praśaśaṃsa punaḥpunaḥ .. 157 ..
4.25.d:
भुक्त्वा तुष्टो द्विजश्रेष्ठो युयुजे परमाशिषम् ॥
जगाम स्वालयं तूर्णं प्रशशंस पुनःपुनः ॥ 157 ॥
4.25.m:
Having eaten, satisfied, the best of the twice-born bestowed the highest blessing.
He went swiftly to his own abode, praising [the king] again and again.

4.25.s:
uvāca pathi viprendro manasā vismayākulaḥ..
māhātmyaṃ durlabhamaho vaiṣṇavānāmiti dvijaḥ .. 158 ..
tulanīya - śrīmadbhāgavatapurāṇe 9.4 aṃbarīṣa-durvāsopākhyānam
4.25.d:
उवाच पथि विप्रेन्द्रो मनसा विस्मयाकुलः॥
माहात्म्यं दुर्लभमहो वैष्णवानामिति द्विजः ॥ 158 ॥
तुलनीय - श्रीमद्भागवतपुराणे 9.4 अंबरीष-दुर्वासोपाख्यानम्
4.25.m:
On the road, the best of the vipras said, his mind overwhelmed with astonishment,
the twice-born [thinking]: 'Ah, how rarely attained is the greatness of the Vaiṣṇavas!'
To be compared with: Śrīmadbhāgavatapurāṇa 9.4, the episode of Ambarīṣa and Durvāsas.

4.26.s:
nārada uvāca ..
dvādaśīlaṅghane doṣaḥ śrutastvanmukhato mune ..
parābhavo muneścaiva nṛpatrāṇaṃ hareraho .. 1 ..
4.26.d:
नारद उवाच ॥
द्वादशीलङ्घने दोषः श्रुतस्त्वन्मुखतो मुने ॥
पराभवो मुनेश्चैव नृपत्राणं हरेरहो ॥ 1 ॥

4.26.s:
adhunā śrotumicchāmi sarveṣāmīpsitaṃ ca me ..
ekādaśīvratasyāsya vidhānaṃ vada niścitam .. 2 ..
4.26.d:
अधुना श्रोतुमिच्छामि सर्वेषामीप्सितं च मे ॥
एकादशीव्रतस्यास्य विधानं वद निश्चितम् ॥ 2 ॥

4.26.s:
aho śrutau śrutaṃ kiṃcinmatabhedānna niścitam ..
śrutīnāṃ kāraṇamukhācchrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ mama .. 3 ..
4.26.d:
अहो श्रुतौ श्रुतं किंचिन्मतभेदान्न निश्चितम् ॥
श्रुतीनां कारणमुखाच्छ्रोतुं कौतूहलं मम ॥ 3 ॥

4.26.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
ekādaśīvratamidaṃ devānāmapi durlabham ..
śrīkṛṣṇaprītijanakaṃ tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ tapasvinām ..4..
4.26.d:
नारायण उवाच ॥
एकादशीव्रतमिदं देवानामपि दुर्लभम् ॥
श्रीकृष्णप्रीतिजनकं तपः श्रेष्ठं तपस्विनाम् ॥4॥

4.26.s:
devānāṃ ca yathā kṛṣṇo devīnāṃ prakṛtiryathā ..
āśramāṇāṃ yathā vipro vaiṣṇavānāṃ yathā śivaḥ ..5..
4.26.d:
देवानां च यथा कृष्णो देवीनां प्रकृतिर्यथा ॥
आश्रमाणां यथा विप्रो वैष्णवानां यथा शिवः ॥5॥

4.26.s:
yathā gaṇeśaḥ pūjyānāṃ yathā vāṇī vipaścitām ..
śāstrāṇāṃ ca yathā vedāstīrthānāṃ jāhnavī yathā ..6..
4.26.d:
यथा गणेशः पूज्यानां यथा वाणी विपश्चिताम् ॥
शास्त्राणां च यथा वेदास्तीर्थानां जाह्नवी यथा ॥6॥

4.26.s:
taijasānāṃ yathā svarṇaṃ prāṇināṃ vaiṣṇavo yathā ..
dhanānāṃ ca yathā vidyā saṅgināṃ ca yathā priyā ..7..
4.26.d:
तैजसानां यथा स्वर्णं प्राणिनां वैष्णवो यथा ॥
धनानां च यथा विद्या सङ्गिनां च यथा प्रिया ॥7॥

4.26.s:
pramathānāṃ yathā rudraḥ śreyasāṃ ca yathā matiḥ..
ātmā yathendriyāṇāṃ ca cañcalānāṃ yathā manaḥ ..8..
4.26.d:
प्रमथानां यथा रुद्रः श्रेयसां च यथा मतिः॥
आत्मा यथेन्द्रियाणां च चञ्चलानां यथा मनः ॥8॥

4.26.s:
gurustrīṇāṃ yathā mātā bandhūnāṃ ca yathā patiḥ ..
baliṣṭhānāṃ yathā daivaṃ kālaḥ kalayatāṃ yathā ..9..
4.26.d:
गुरुस्त्रीणां यथा माता बन्धूनां च यथा पतिः ॥
बलिष्ठानां यथा दैवं कालः कलयतां यथा ॥9॥

4.26.s:
suśīlaṃ caiva mitrāṇāṃ śatrūṇāṃ rugyathā mune ..
yathā kīrtiḥ kīrtimatāṃ gṛhiṇāṃ ca yathā gṛham .. 4.26.10..
4.26.d:
सुशीलं चैव मित्राणां शत्रूणां रुग्यथा मुने ॥
यथा कीर्तिः कीर्तिमतां गृहिणां च यथा गृहम् ॥ 4.26.10॥

4.26.s:
yathā khalo hiṃsakānāṃ duṣṭānāṃ caiva puṃścalī ..
tejasvināṃ graheśaśca sahiṣṇūnāṃ yathā kṣitiḥ .. 11 ..
4.26.d:
यथा खलो हिंसकानां दुष्टानां चैव पुंश्चली ॥
तेजस्विनां ग्रहेशश्च सहिष्णूनां यथा क्षितिः ॥ 11 ॥

4.26.s:
yathā'mṛtaṃ bhakṣaṇānāṃ dāhakānāṃ yathā'nalaḥ ..
yathā śrīrdhanadātṝṇāṃ satīnāṃ ca yathā satī .. 12 ..
4.26.d:
यथाऽमृतं भक्षणानां दाहकानां यथाऽनलः ॥
यथा श्रीर्धनदातॄणां सतीनां च यथा सती ॥ 12 ॥

4.26.s:
prajeśānāṃ yathā brahmā saritāṃ sāgaro yathā ..
yathā sāma śrutīnāṃ ca gāyatrī chandasāṃ yathā ..13..
4.26.d:
प्रजेशानां यथा ब्रह्मा सरितां सागरो यथा ॥
यथा साम श्रुतीनां च गायत्री छन्दसां यथा ॥13॥

4.26.s:
vṛkṣāṇāṃ ca yathā'śvatthaḥ puṣpāṇāṃ tulasī yathā ..
yathā mārgo hi māsānāmṛtūnāṃ ca yathā madhuḥ .. 14 ..
4.26.d:
वृक्षाणां च यथाऽश्वत्थः पुष्पाणां तुलसी यथा ॥
यथा मार्गो हि मासानामृतूनां च यथा मधुः ॥ 14 ॥

4.26.s:
ādityānāṃ yathā sūryo rudrāṇāṃ śaṃkaro yathā..
yathā bhīṣmo vasūnāṃ ca varṣāṇāṃ bhārataṃ yathā .. 15 ..
4.26.d:
आदित्यानां यथा सूर्यो रुद्राणां शंकरो यथा॥
यथा भीष्मो वसूनां च वर्षाणां भारतं यथा ॥ 15 ॥

4.26.s:
devarṣīṇāṃ yathā tvaṃ ca brahmarṣīṇāṃ yathā bhṛguḥ ..
nṛpāṇāṃ ca yathā rāmaḥ siddhānāṃ kapilo yathā .. 16 ..
4.26.d:
देवर्षीणां यथा त्वं च ब्रह्मर्षीणां यथा भृगुः ॥
नृपाणां च यथा रामः सिद्धानां कपिलो यथा ॥ 16 ॥

4.26.s:
yathā sanatkumāraśca yogināṃ jñānināṃ varaḥ ..
airāvato gajendrāṇāṃ paśūnāṃ śarabho yathā .. 17 ..
4.26.d:
यथा सनत्कुमारश्च योगिनां ज्ञानिनां वरः ॥
ऐरावतो गजेन्द्राणां पशूनां शरभो यथा ॥ 17 ॥

4.26.s:
yathā himādriḥ śailānāṃ maṇīnāṃ kaustubho yathā ..
sarasvatī nadīnāṃ ca yathā puṇyasvarūpiṇī .. 18 ..
4.26.d:
यथा हिमाद्रिः शैलानां मणीनां कौस्तुभो यथा ॥
सरस्वती नदीनां च यथा पुण्यस्वरूपिणी ॥ 18 ॥

4.26.s:
gandharvāṇāṃ citraratho yathā śreṣṭhaśca nārada ..
yathā kubero yakṣāṇāṃ sumālī rakṣasāṃ yathā .. 19 ..
4.26.d:
गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथो यथा श्रेष्ठश्च नारद ॥
यथा कुबेरो यक्षाणां सुमाली रक्षसां यथा ॥ 19 ॥

4.26.s:
yathā śreṣṭhā ca nārīṇāṃ śatarūpā varā parā ..
manūnāṃ ca yathā śreṣṭhaḥ svayaṃ svāyaṃbhuvo manuḥ ..4.26.20..
4.26.d:
यथा श्रेष्ठा च नारीणां शतरूपा वरा परा ॥
मनूनां च यथा श्रेष्ठः स्वयं स्वायंभुवो मनुः ॥4.26.20॥

4.26.s:
sundarīṇāṃ yathā rambhā yathā māyā ca māyinām ..
ekādaśīvratamidaṃ vratānāṃ ca varaṃ tathā ..21..
4.26.d:
सुन्दरीणां यथा रम्भा यथा माया च मायिनाम् ॥
एकादशीव्रतमिदं व्रतानां च वरं तथा ॥21॥

4.26.s:
kartavyaṃ ca caturṇāṃ ca varṇānāṃ nityameva ca ..
yatīnāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 22 ..
4.26.d:
कर्तव्यं च चतुर्णां च वर्णानां नित्यमेव च ॥
यतीनां वैष्णवानां ब्राह्मणानां विशेषतः ॥ 22 ॥

4.26.s:
satyaṃ sarvāṇi pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca ..
santyevaudanamāśritya śrīkṛṣṇavratavāsare .. 23 ..
4.26.d:
सत्यं सर्वाणि पापानि ब्रह्महत्यादिकानि च ॥
सन्त्येवौदनमाश्रित्य श्रीकृष्णव्रतवासरे ॥ 23 ॥

4.26.s:
bhuktvaitāni ca pāpāni yo bhuṅkte tatra mandadhīḥ ..
ihātipātakī so'pi yātyante narakaṃ dhruvam..24..
4.26.d:
भुक्त्वैतानि च पापानि यो भुङ्क्ते तत्र मन्दधीः ॥
इहातिपातकी सोऽपि यात्यन्ते नरकं ध्रुवम्॥24॥

4.26.s:
ekādaśīpramāṇāni yugasaṃkhyākṛtāni ca ..
kumbhīpāke mahāghore sthitvā caṇḍālatāṃ vrajet..29..
galitavyādhiyuktaśca tataḥ saptasu janmasu..
paścānmukto bhavetpāpādityāha kamalodbhavaḥ ..29..
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ brahmanyo doṣastatra bhojane ..
dvādaśīlaṅghane doṣo mayoktaśca śrutaḥ purā ..27..
daśamīlaṅghane doṣaṃ nibodha kathayāmi te ..
purā śruto dharmavaktrādvedasāroddhṛto'pi ca ..28..
daśamīṃ yaḥ kalāmātrāṃ mūḍho'jñānena laṅghayet ..
yāti śrīstadgṛhāttūrṇaṃ śāpaṃ dattvā tu dāruṇam ..29..
4.26.d:
एकादशीप्रमाणानि युगसंख्याकृतानि च ॥
कुम्भीपाके महाघोरे स्थित्वा चण्डालतां व्रजेत्॥29॥
गलितव्याधियुक्तश्च ततः सप्तसु जन्मसु॥
पश्चान्मुक्तो भवेत्पापादित्याह कमलोद्भवः ॥29॥
इत्येवं कथितं ब्रह्मन्यो दोषस्तत्र भोजने ॥
द्वादशीलङ्घने दोषो मयोक्तश्च श्रुतः पुरा ॥27॥
दशमीलङ्घने दोषं निबोध कथयामि ते ॥
पुरा श्रुतो धर्मवक्त्राद्वेदसारोद्धृतोऽपि च ॥28॥
दशमीं यः कलामात्रां मूढोऽज्ञानेन लङ्घयेत् ॥
याति श्रीस्तद्गृहात्तूर्णं शापं दत्त्वा तु दारुणम् ॥29॥

4.26.s:
iha tadvaṃśahāniśca yaśohānirbhaveddhruvam ..
ante manvantaraśatamandhakūpe vaseddvija ..4.26.30..
4.26.d:
इह तद्वंशहानिश्च यशोहानिर्भवेद्ध्रुवम् ॥
अन्ते मन्वन्तरशतमन्धकूपे वसेद्द्विज ॥4.26.30॥

4.26.s:
daśamyekādaśī vāpi dvādaśī yatra vāsare ..
tatra bhuktvā paradine upoṣya vratamācaret ..31..
4.26.d:
दशम्येकादशी वापि द्वादशी यत्र वासरे ॥
तत्र भुक्त्वा परदिने उपोष्य व्रतमाचरेत् ॥31॥

4.26.s:
dvādaśyāṃ ca vrataṃ kṛtvā trayodaśyāṃ ca pāraṇam ..
dvādaśīlaṅghane doṣo vratināṃ tanna vidyate .. 32 ..
4.26.d:
द्वादश्यां च व्रतं कृत्वा त्रयोदश्यां च पारणम् ॥
द्वादशीलङ्घने दोषो व्रतिनां तन्न विद्यते ॥ 32 ॥

4.26.s:
saṃpūrṇaikādaśī yatra prabhāte kiṃcideva sā..
tatropoṣyā dvitīyā ca parā cedyadi vardhate ..33..
4.26.d:
संपूर्णैकादशी यत्र प्रभाते किंचिदेव सा॥
तत्रोपोष्या द्वितीया च परा चेद्यदि वर्धते ॥33॥
4.26.m:
Where there is a complete Ekādaśī, and in the morning there is only a little of it,
the fast is to be observed on the second day, if the subsequent one extends.

4.26.s:
ṣaṣṭidaṇḍātmikā yatra prabhāte ca tithitrayam ..
kurvanti gṛhiṇaḥ pūrvaṃ caiva yatyādayastathā ..34..
4.26.d:
षष्टिदण्डात्मिका यत्र प्रभाते च तिथित्रयम् ॥
कुर्वन्ति गृहिणः पूर्वं चैव यत्यादयस्तथा ॥34॥
4.26.m:
Where there are sixty daṇḍas, and in the morning there are three lunar days,
householders observe the former, as do ascetics and others.

4.26.s:
paratrānaśanaṃ kṛtvā nityakṛtyaṃ samācaret ..
vrate jāgaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvatraivācaredbudhaḥ ..35..
4.26.d:
परत्रानशनं कृत्वा नित्यकृत्यं समाचरेत् ॥
व्रते जागरणं सर्वं पूर्वत्रैवाचरेद्बुधः ॥35॥
4.26.m:
Having observed non-eating on the latter day, one should perform the daily rites;
the wise person should keep the whole vigil for the vow on the former day alone.

4.26.s:
tatpūrvadivase nityaṃ vrate kṛtvā pare'hani ..
ekādaśyāṃ vyatītāyāṃ pāraṇaṃ tu samācaret .. 36 ..
4.26.d:
तत्पूर्वदिवसे नित्यं व्रते कृत्वा परेऽहनि ॥
एकादश्यां व्यतीतायां पारणं तु समाचरेत् ॥ 36 ॥
4.26.m:
Having performed the daily rite on the day before it, and on the next day during the vow,
when Ekādaśī has passed, one should break the fast.

4.26.s:
vaiṣṇavānāṃ yatīnāṃ ca vidhavānāṃ tathaiva ca ..
sarvāḥ samā upoṣyāstā bhikṣūṇāṃ brahmacāriṇām .. 37 ..
4.26.d:
वैष्णवानां यतीनां च विधवानां तथैव च ॥
सर्वाः समा उपोष्यास्ता भिक्षूणां ब्रह्मचारिणाम् ॥ 37 ॥
4.26.m:
For Vaiṣṇavas, ascetics, and widows alike,
all [Ekādaśīs] are to be fasted equally, [as also] for mendicants and religious students.

4.26.s:
śuklāmeva tu kurvanti gṛhiṇo vaiṣṇavetarāḥ ..
na kṛṣṇālaṅghane doṣasteṣāṃ vedeṣu nārada .. 38 ..
4.26.d:
शुक्लामेव तु कुर्वन्ति गृहिणो वैष्णवेतराः ॥
न कृष्णालङ्घने दोषस्तेषां वेदेषु नारद ॥ 38 ॥
4.26.m:
Householders who are other than Vaiṣṇavas observe only the bright fortnight;
in the Vedas there is no fault for them in skipping the dark fortnight, O Nārada.

4.26.s:
śayanībodhinīmadhye yā kṛṣṇaikādaśī bhavet ..
saivopoṣyā gṛhasthena nānyā kṛṣṇā kadācana ..39..
4.26.d:
शयनीबोधिनीमध्ये या कृष्णैकादशी भवेत् ॥
सैवोपोष्या गृहस्थेन नान्या कृष्णा कदाचन ॥39॥
4.26.m:
Whatever dark Ekādaśī falls between Śayanī and Bodhinī,
that alone is to be fasted by a householder, no other dark one ever.

4.26.s:
ityevaṃ kathito brahmannirṇayo'yaṃ śrutau śrutaḥ ..
vratasyāsya vidhānaṃ ca nibodha kathayāmi te .. 4.26.40 ..
4.26.d:
इत्येवं कथितो ब्रह्मन्निर्णयोऽयं श्रुतौ श्रुतः ॥
व्रतस्यास्य विधानं च निबोध कथयामि ते ॥ 4.26.40 ॥
4.26.m:
Thus, O Brahmin, has been stated this conclusion heard in revelation.
Now understand the procedure for this vow; I shall declare it to you:

4.26.s:
kṛtvā haviṣyaṃ pūrvāhṇe na ca bhuṅkte punarjalam ..
ekākī kuśaśayyāyāṃ naktaṃ śayanamācaret .. 41 ..
4.26.d:
कृत्वा हविष्यं पूर्वाह्णे न च भुङ्क्ते पुनर्जलम् ॥
एकाकी कुशशय्यायां नक्तं शयनमाचरेत् ॥ 41 ॥
4.26.m:
Having taken sacrificial food in the morning, one does not drink even water again;
alone, one should sleep at night on a bed of kuśa grass.

4.26.s:
brāhme muhūrte cotthāya prātaḥkṛtyaṃ vidhāya ca ..
nityakṛtyaṃ vidhāyātha tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret .. .. 42 ..
4.26.d:
ब्राह्मे मुहूर्ते चोत्थाय प्रातःकृत्यं विधाय च ॥
नित्यकृत्यं विधायाथ ततः स्नानं समाचरेत् ॥ ॥ 42 ॥
4.26.m:
Rising at the brahma-muhūrta and having attended to morning duties,
having carried out daily duties, one should then take a bath.

4.26.s:
vratopavāsaṃ saṃkalpya śrīkṛṣṇaprītipūrvakam ..
kṛtvā sandhyāṃ tarpaṇaṃ ca vidhāyāhnikamācaret .. 43 ..
4.26.d:
व्रतोपवासं संकल्प्य श्रीकृष्णप्रीतिपूर्वकम् ॥
कृत्वा सन्ध्यां तर्पणं च विधायाह्निकमाचरेत् ॥ 43 ॥
4.26.m:
Having made the solemn resolve to fast for the vow, dedicated to the pleasure of Śrī Kṛṣṇa,
having performed the twilight worship and libation, one should execute the daily observances.

4.26.s:
nityapūjāṃ dine kṛtvā vratadravyaṃ samāharet ..
kṛtvā ṣoḍaśopacāraṃ pradṛṣṭaṃ vidhibodhitam .. 44 ..
4.26.d:
नित्यपूजां दिने कृत्वा व्रतद्रव्यं समाहरेत् ॥
कृत्वा षोडशोपचारं प्रदृष्टं विधिबोधितम् ॥ 44 ॥
4.26.m:
Having done the daily worship during the day, one should collect the items for the vow,
preparing the sixteen articles of worship prescribed according to rule:

4.26.s:
āsanaṃ vasanaṃ pādyamarghyaṃ puṣpānulepanam ..
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ yajñasūtraṃ ca bhūṣaṇam .. 45 ..
4.26.d:
आसनं वसनं पाद्यमर्घ्यं पुष्पानुलेपनम् ॥
धूपं दीपं च नैवेद्यं यज्ञसूत्रं च भूषणम् ॥ 45 ॥
4.26.m:
seat, garments, water for the feet, arghya offering, flowers, ointment,
incense, a lamp, food offering, sacred thread, ornaments,

4.26.s:
gandhaṃ snānīyatāmbūle madhuparkaṃ punarjalam ..
etānyāhṛtya divase vrataṃ naktaṃ samācaret .. 46 ..
4.26.d:
गन्धं स्नानीयताम्बूले मधुपर्कं पुनर्जलम् ॥
एतान्याहृत्य दिवसे व्रतं नक्तं समाचरेत् ॥ 46 ॥
4.26.m:
fragrance, bath water, betel, madhuparka, and water again.
Having collected these during the day, one should perform the vow at night.

4.26.s:
upaviśyāsane pūto dhṛtvā dhauteyavāsasī ..
ācamya śrīhariṃ natvā svastivācanamācaret.. 47 ..
4.26.d:
उपविश्यासने पूतो धृत्वा धौतेयवाससी ॥
आचम्य श्रीहरिं नत्वा स्वस्तिवाचनमाचरेत्॥ 47 ॥
4.26.m:
Sitting on a seat, purified, wearing two washed garments,
having sipped water and bowed to Śrī Hari, one should recite auspicious benedictions.

4.26.s:
āropya maṅgalaghaṭaṃ dhānyādhāre śubhe kṣaṇe ..
phalaśākhācaṃdanāktaṃ vedoktaṃ munibhirmudā ..48..
4.26.d:
आरोप्य मङ्गलघटं धान्याधारे शुभे क्षणे ॥
फलशाखाचंदनाक्तं वेदोक्तं मुनिभिर्मुदा ॥48॥
4.26.m:
Setting up the auspicious pot upon a bed of grain at an auspicious moment,
furnished with fruits, branches, and sandalwood paste, as taught in the Vedas by sages with joy,

4.26.s:
devaṣaṭkaṃ samāvāhya pṛthagdhānyaiḥ samācaret ..
pūjāṃ pañcopacāraiśca prakṛṣṭaiśca vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 49 ..
4.26.d:
देवषट्कं समावाह्य पृथग्धान्यैः समाचरेत् ॥
पूजां पञ्चोपचारैश्च प्रकृष्टैश्च विचक्षणः ॥ 49 ॥
4.26.m:
having invoked the six deities with separate grains, the wise person
should perform the worship with the five excellent offerings:

4.26.s:
gaṇeśvaraṃ dinakaraṃ vahniṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ śivām ..
saṃpūjyaitānpraṇamyātha vrataṃ kuryāddhariṃ smaran .. 4.26.50 ..
4.26.d:
गणेश्वरं दिनकरं वह्निं विष्णुं शिवं शिवाम् ॥
संपूज्यैतान्प्रणम्याथ व्रतं कुर्याद्धरिं स्मरन् ॥ 4.26.50 ॥
4.26.m:
Gaṇeśvara, the Sun, Fire, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and Śivā.
Having worshipped these and bowed down, one should perform the vow remembering Hari.

4.26.s:
nārādhya devaṣaṭkaṃ ca yadi karma samācaret ..
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ cāpi tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet .. 51 ..
4.26.d:
नाराध्य देवषट्कं च यदि कर्म समाचरेत् ॥
नित्यं नैमित्तिकं चापि तत्सर्वं निष्फलं भवेत् ॥ 51 ॥
4.26.m:
If one undertakes a ritual without having worshipped the six deities,
whether daily or occasional, it all becomes fruitless.

4.26.s:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ vratāṅgabhūtameva ca ..
kaṇvaśākhoktamiṣṭaṃ ca vrataṃ śṛṇu mahāmune ..52 ..
4.26.d:
इत्येवं कथितं सर्वं व्रताङ्गभूतमेव च ॥
कण्वशाखोक्तमिष्टं च व्रतं शृणु महामुने ॥52 ॥
4.26.m:
Thus all the ancillary rites of the vow have been described.
Now hear the beloved vow taught in the Kaṇva recension, O great sage:

4.26.s:
sāmavedoktadhyānena dhyātvā kṛṣṇaṃ parātparam ..
puṣpaṃ ca śirasi nyasya punardhyānaṃ samācaret ..93..
4.26.d:
सामवेदोक्तध्यानेन ध्यात्वा कृष्णं परात्परम् ॥
पुष्पं च शिरसि न्यस्य पुनर्ध्यानं समाचरेत् ॥93॥
4.26.m:
Having meditated on Kṛṣṇa, higher than the highest, through the visualization taught in the Sāmaveda,
And placing a flower on his head, he should perform meditation again. (53)

4.26.s:
dhyānaṃ śṛṇu nigūḍhaṃ ca sarveṣāmapi vāñchitam ..
na prakāśyamabhaktāya bhaktaprāṇādhikaṃ param ..54 ..
4.26.d:
ध्यानं शृणु निगूढं च सर्वेषामपि वाञ्छितम् ॥
न प्रकाश्यमभक्ताय भक्तप्राणाधिकं परम् ॥54 ॥
4.26.m:
Hear the meditation, secret and desired by all,
not to be revealed to a non-devotee, supreme, dearer than life to a devotee. (54)

4.26.s:
navīnanīrado yadvacchyāmasundaravigraham ..
śaratpārvaṇacandrābhāvinindyāsyamanuttamam .. 55 ..
4.26.d:
नवीननीरदो यद्वच्छ्यामसुन्दरविग्रहम् ॥
शरत्पार्वणचन्द्राभाविनिन्द्यास्यमनुत्तमम् ॥ 55 ॥
4.26.m:
He whose dark, beautiful form is like a fresh raincloud,
whose incomparable, irreproachable face shines like the full autumn moon, (55)

4.26.s:
śaratsūryodayābjānāṃ prabhāmocanalocanam..
svāṃgasauṃdaryaśobhābhī ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam ..56..
4.26.d:
शरत्सूर्योदयाब्जानां प्रभामोचनलोचनम्॥
स्वांगसौंदर्यशोभाभी रत्नभूषणभूषितम् ॥56॥
4.26.m:
whose eyes dispel the luster of lotus flowers opening to the autumn sun,
who is adorned with jewel ornaments by the radiant beauty of his own limbs, (56)

4.26.s:
gopīlocanakoṇaiśca prasannairatisūcakaiḥ ..
śaśvannirīkṣyamāṇaṃ tatprāṇairiva vinirmitam .. 57 ..
4.26.d:
गोपीलोचनकोणैश्च प्रसन्नैरतिसूचकैः ॥
शश्वन्निरीक्ष्यमाणं तत्प्राणैरिव विनिर्मितम् ॥ 57 ॥
4.26.m:
who, as if formed from their vital breaths,
is constantly gazed upon by the bright, highly expressive corners of the gopīs' eyes, (57)

4.26.s:
rāsamaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ rāsollāsasamutsukam..
rādhāvaktraśaraccandrasudhāpānacakorakam..58..
4.26.d:
रासमण्डलमध्यस्थं रासोल्लाससमुत्सुकम्॥
राधावक्त्रशरच्चन्द्रसुधापानचकोरकम्॥58॥
4.26.m: a cakora bird drinking the nectar of the autumn moon that is Rādhā's face, (58)

4.26.s:
kaustubhena maṇīndreṇa vakṣaḥsthalasamujjvalam..
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālairvirājitam .. 59 ..
4.26.d:
कौस्तुभेन मणीन्द्रेण वक्षःस्थलसमुज्ज्वलम्॥
पारिजातप्रसूनानां मालाजालैर्विराजितम् ॥ 59 ॥

4.26.s:
sadratnasāranirmāṇaṃ kirīṭojjvalaśekharam ..
vinodamuralīnyastahastaṃ pūjyaṃ surāsuraiḥ .. 4.26.60 ..
4.26.d:
सद्रत्नसारनिर्माणं किरीटोज्ज्वलशेखरम् ॥
विनोदमुरलीन्यस्तहस्तं पूज्यं सुरासुरैः ॥ 4.26.60 ॥
4.26.m:
whose crest is bright with a diadem fashioned from the essence of fine gems,
whose hand rests upon his playful flute, who is worthy of worship by gods and demons, (60)

4.26.s:
dhyānāsādhyaṃ durārādhyaṃ brahmādīnāṃ ca vanditam ..
kāraṇaṃ kāraṇānāṃ yastamīśvaramahaṃ bhaje .. 61 ..
4.26.d:
ध्यानासाध्यं दुराराध्यं ब्रह्मादीनां च वन्दितम् ॥
कारणं कारणानां यस्तमीश्वरमहं भजे ॥ 61 ॥
4.26.m:
unattainable by meditation, difficult to propitiate, and praised by Brahmā and the other [gods]—
I worship that Lord, who is the cause of all causes. (61)

4.26.s:
dhyātvā'nena tamāvāhya copahārāṇi ṣoḍaśa ..
dattvā saṃpūjayedbhaktyā mantrairebhiśca nārada .. 62 ..
4.26.d:
ध्यात्वाऽनेन तमावाह्य चोपहाराणि षोडश ॥
दत्त्वा संपूजयेद्भक्त्या मन्त्रैरेभिश्च नारद ॥ 62 ॥
4.26.m:
Having meditated in this way, having invoked him, and offering sixteen articles of worship
with devotion, he should worship [him] with these mantras, O Nārada: (62)

4.26.s:
āsanaṃ svarṇanirmāṇaṃ ratnasāraparicchadam ..
nānācitra vicitrāḍhyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ parameśvara .. 63 ..
4.26.d:
आसनं स्वर्णनिर्माणं रत्नसारपरिच्छदम् ॥
नानाचित्र विचित्राढ्यं गृह्यतां परमेश्वर ॥ 63 ॥
4.26.m:
“This seat, made of gold, covered with the essence of gems,
and richly adorned with various curious patterns, may it be accepted, O Supreme Lord! (63)

4.26.s:
vahniprakṣālitaṃ vastraṃ nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā ..
mūlyānirvacanīyaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ rādhikāpate .. .. 64 ..
4.26.d:
वह्निप्रक्षालितं वस्त्रं निर्मितं विश्वकर्मणा ॥
मूल्यानिर्वचनीयं च गृह्यतां राधिकापते ॥ ॥ 64 ॥
4.26.m:
This garment, cleansed by fire, fashioned by Viśvakarman
and of inestimable value, may it be accepted, O Lord of Rādhikā! (64)

4.26.s:
pādaprakṣālanārhaṃ ca suvarṇapātrasaṃsthitam ..
suvāsitaṃ śītalaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ karuṇānidhe .. 65 ..
4.26.d:
पादप्रक्षालनार्हं च सुवर्णपात्रसंस्थितम् ॥
सुवासितं शीतलं च गृह्यतां करुणानिधे ॥ 65 ॥
4.26.m:
This [water] suitable for washing the feet, resting in a golden vessel,
fragrant and cool, may it be accepted, O ocean of compassion! (65)

4.26.s:
idamarghyaṃ pavitraṃ ca śaṅkhatoyasamanvitam ..
puṣpadūrvācandanāktaṃ gṛhyatāṃ bhaktavatsala .. 66 ..
4.26.d:
इदमर्घ्यं पवित्रं च शङ्खतोयसमन्वितम् ॥
पुष्पदूर्वाचन्दनाक्तं गृह्यतां भक्तवत्सल ॥ 66 ॥
4.26.m:
This pure arghya-offering, accompanied by conch-water,
smeared with flowers, dūrvā grass, and sandalwood, may it be accepted, O lover of devotees! (66)

4.26.s:
suvāsitaṃ śuklapuṣpaṃ candanāgurusaṃyutam ..
sadyaste prītijanakaṃ gṛhyatāṃ sarvakāraṇa .. 67 ..
4.26.d:
सुवासितं शुक्लपुष्पं चन्दनागुरुसंयुतम् ॥
सद्यस्ते प्रीतिजनकं गृह्यतां सर्वकारण ॥ 67 ॥
4.26.m:
This fragrant white flower, combined with sandalwood and agallochum,
producing immediate delight in you, may it be accepted, O Cause of all! (67)

4.26.s:
candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumośīramuttamam ..
sarvepsitamidaṃ kṛṣṇa gṛhyatāmanulepanam .. 68 ..
4.26.d:
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरीकुङ्कुमोशीरमुत्तमम् ॥
सर्वेप्सितमिदं कृष्ण गृह्यतामनुलेपनम् ॥ 68 ॥
4.26.m:
This excellent [unguent] of sandalwood, agallochum, musk, saffron, and uśīra,
desired by all, this ointment, O Kṛṣṇa, may it be accepted! (68)

4.26.s:
raso vṛkṣaviśeṣasya nānādravyasamanvitaḥ..
sugandhiyuktaḥ sukhado dhūpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām .. 69 ..
4.26.d:
रसो वृक्षविशेषस्य नानाद्रव्यसमन्वितः॥
सुगन्धियुक्तः सुखदो धूपोऽयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् ॥ 69 ॥
4.26.m:
The sap of a special tree, mixed with various substances,
endowed with fragrance, bestowing pleasure—may this incense be accepted! (69)

4.26.s:
divāniśaṃ supradīpto ratnasāravinirmitaḥ ..
punardhvāntanāśabījaṃ dīpo'yaṃ pratigṛhyatām .. 4.26.70 ..
4.26.d:
दिवानिशं सुप्रदीप्तो रत्नसारविनिर्मितः ॥
पुनर्ध्वान्तनाशबीजं दीपोऽयं प्रतिगृह्यताम् ॥ 4.26.70 ॥
4.26.m:
Shining brightly day and night, fashioned from the essence of jewels,
a source of destruction for darkness, may this lamp be accepted! (70)

4.26.s:
nānāvidhāni dravyāṇi svādūni surabhīṇi ca ..
coṣyādīni pavitrāṇi svātmārāma pragṛhyatām ..71..
4.26.d:
नानाविधानि द्रव्याणि स्वादूनि सुरभीणि च ॥
चोष्यादीनि पवित्राणि स्वात्माराम प्रगृह्यताम् ॥71॥
4.26.m:
These various kinds of foods, savory and fragrant,
suckable and the rest, pure, O one delighting in the Self, may they be accepted! (71)

4.26.s:
sāvitrīgranthisayuktaṃ svarṇatantuvinirmitam ..
gṛhyatāṃ devadeveśa racitaṃ cāru kāruṇā..72..
4.26.d:
सावित्रीग्रन्थिसयुक्तं स्वर्णतन्तुविनिर्मितम् ॥
गृह्यतां देवदेवेश रचितं चारु कारुणा॥72॥
4.26.m:
Tied with the Sāvitrī knot, made of golden threads,
beautifully crafted by an artisan, may it be accepted, O Lord of the gods of gods! (72)

4.26.s:
amūlyaratnaracitaṃ sarvā vayavabhūṣaṇam..
tviṣā jājvalyamānaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ nandanandana..73..
4.26.d:
अमूल्यरत्नरचितं सर्वा वयवभूषणम्॥
त्विषा जाज्वल्यमानं च गृह्यतां नन्दनन्दन॥73॥
4.26.m:
Fashioned from priceless jewels, an ornament for every limb,
blazing with brilliance, may it be accepted, O Son of Nanda! (73)

4.26.s:
pradhāno varṇanīyaśca sarvamaṅgalakarmaṇi ..
pragṛhyatāṃ dīnabandho gandho'yaṃ maṅgalapradaḥ ..74..
4.26.d:
प्रधानो वर्णनीयश्च सर्वमङ्गलकर्मणि ॥
प्रगृह्यतां दीनबन्धो गन्धोऽयं मङ्गलप्रदः ॥74॥
4.26.m:
Foremost and worthy of praise in every auspicious rite,
may this fragrance conferring auspiciousness be accepted, O friend of the wretched! (74)

4.26.s:
dhātrī śrīphalapatrotthaṃ viṣṇutailaṃ manoharam..
vāñchitaṃ sarvalokānāṃ bhagavanpratigṛhyatām ..75..
4.26.d:
धात्री श्रीफलपत्रोत्थं विष्णुतैलं मनोहरम्॥
वाञ्छितं सर्वलोकानां भगवन्प्रतिगृह्यताम् ॥75॥
4.26.m:
This charming Viṣṇu-oil, derived from myrobalan and bilva leaves,
desired by all the worlds, O Lord, may it be accepted! (75)

4.26.s:
vāñchanīyaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam..
mayā niveditaṃ nātha tāmbūlaṃ pratigṛhyatām..76..
4.26.d:
वाञ्छनीयं च सर्वेषां कर्पूरादिसुवासितम्॥
मया निवेदितं नाथ ताम्बूलं प्रतिगृह्यताम्॥76॥
4.26.m:
Desired by all, fragranced with camphor and the like,
offered by me, O Master, may this betel be accepted! (76)

4.26.s:
sarveṣāṃ prītijanakaṃ sumiṣṭaṃ madhuraṃ madhu..
sadratnasārapātrasthaṃ gopīkānta pragṛhyatām .. 77 ..
4.26.d:
सर्वेषां प्रीतिजनकं सुमिष्टं मधुरं मधु॥
सद्रत्नसारपात्रस्थं गोपीकान्त प्रगृह्यताम् ॥ 77 ॥
4.26.m:
Producing delight in all, very sweet, delicious honey,
placed in a vessel of the essence of fine gems, O beloved of the gopīs, may it be accepted! (77)

4.26.s:
nirmalaṃ jāhnavītoyaṃ supavitraṃ suvāsitam ..
punarācamanīyaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ madhusūdana .. 78 ..
4.26.d:
निर्मलं जाह्नवीतोयं सुपवित्रं सुवासितम् ॥
पुनराचमनीयं च गृह्यतां मधुसूदन ॥ 78 ॥
4.26.m:
Pure water of the Gaṅgā, exceedingly sacred and fragrant,
water for rinsing the mouth once more, may it be accepted, O Madhusūdana!” (78)

4.26.s:
iti ṣoḍaśopacārāndattvā bhakto mudā'nvitaḥ ..
mantreṇānena puṣpāṇi mālyaṃ dattvā prayatnataḥ ..79..
4.26.d:
इति षोडशोपचारान्दत्त्वा भक्तो मुदाऽन्वितः ॥
मन्त्रेणानेन पुष्पाणि माल्यं दत्त्वा प्रयत्नतः ॥79॥
4.26.m:
Having thus offered the sixteen services, the devotee, filled with joy,
carefully offering flowers and a garland with this mantra: (79)

4.26.s:
nānāprakārapuṣpaiśca grathitaṃ śuklatantunā ..
pravaraṃ bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca mālyaṃ ca gṛhyatāṃ prabho .. 4.26.80 ..
4.26.d:
नानाप्रकारपुष्पैश्च ग्रथितं शुक्लतन्तुना ॥
प्रवरं भूषणानां च माल्यं च गृह्यतां प्रभो ॥ 4.26.80 ॥
4.26.m:
“Woven from various kinds of flowers with a white thread,
the best of ornaments, may this garland be accepted, O Lord!” (80)

4.26.s:
iti puṣpāñjaliṃ dadyānmūlamantreṇa ca vratī ..
kuryāttatstavanaṃ bhaktyā puṭāñjaliyutaḥ sudhīḥ .. 81 ..
4.26.d:
इति पुष्पाञ्जलिं दद्यान्मूलमन्त्रेण च व्रती ॥
कुर्यात्तत्स्तवनं भक्त्या पुटाञ्जलियुतः सुधीः ॥ 81 ॥
4.26.m:
Thus the practitioner of the vow should offer a handful of flowers with the root mantra;
the wise one, with folded hands, should recite praise to him with devotion: (81)

4.26.s:
bhakta uvāca ..
he kṛṣṇa rādhikānātha karuṇāsāgara prabho ..
saṃsārasāgare ghore māmuddhara bhayānake .. 82 ..
4.26.d:
भक्त उवाच ॥
हे कृष्ण राधिकानाथ करुणासागर प्रभो ॥
संसारसागरे घोरे मामुद्धर भयानके ॥ 82 ॥
4.26.m:
“O Kṛṣṇa, O Lord of Rādhikā, O ocean of mercy, O Lord,
deliver me from this dreadful, terrifying ocean of transmigration! (82)”

4.26.s:
śatajanmakṛtāyāsādudvignasya mama prabho ..
svakarmapāśanigaḍairbaddhasya mokṣaṇaṃ kuru .. 83 ..
4.26.d:
शतजन्मकृतायासादुद्विग्नस्य मम प्रभो ॥
स्वकर्मपाशनिगडैर्बद्धस्य मोक्षणं कुरु ॥ 83 ॥
4.26.m:
For me, distressed by the toil performed through a hundred births, O Lord,
bound by the fetters of the cords of my own karma, grant liberation! // 83

4.26.s:
praṇataṃ pādapadme te paśya māṃ śaraṇāgatam ..
bhavapāśabhayādbhītaṃ pāhi tvaṃ śaraṇāgatam .. 84 ..
4.26.d:
प्रणतं पादपद्मे ते पश्य मां शरणागतम् ॥
भवपाशभयाद्भीतं पाहि त्वं शरणागतम् ॥ 84 ॥
4.26.m:
Behold me bowed at your lotus feet, seeking refuge;
terrified by fear of the fetters of worldly existence, protect me who have approached for refuge! // 84

4.26.s:
bhaktihīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ vidhihīnaṃ ca vedataḥ ..
vastumantravihīnaṃ yattatsaṃpūrṇaṃ kuru prabho .. 89 ..
4.26.d:
भक्तिहीनं क्रियाहीनं विधिहीनं च वेदतः ॥
वस्तुमन्त्रविहीनं यत्तत्संपूर्णं कुरु प्रभो ॥ 89 ॥
4.26.m:
Whatever is devoid of devotion, devoid of ritual action, devoid of the Vedic injunctions,
and devoid of the materials and mantras—make that complete, O Lord! // 85

4.26.s:
vedoktavihitā'jñānātsvāṅgahīne ca karmaṇi ..
tvannāmoccāraṇenaiva sarvaṃ pūrṇaṃ bhaveddhare..86..
4.26.d:
वेदोक्तविहिताऽज्ञानात्स्वाङ्गहीने च कर्मणि ॥
त्वन्नामोच्चारणेनैव सर्वं पूर्णं भवेद्धरे॥86॥
4.26.m:
When a rite is defective in its parts through ignorance of what is prescribed by the Veda,
by the utterance of your name alone everything becomes complete, O Hari! // 86

4.26.s:
iti stutvā taṃ praṇamya dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām ..
mahotsavaṃ vidhāyātha kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ vratī ..87..
4.26.d:
इति स्तुत्वा तं प्रणम्य दत्त्वा विप्राय दक्षिणाम् ॥
महोत्सवं विधायाथ कुर्याज्जागरणं व्रती ॥87॥
4.26.m:
Having thus praised him, bowed to him, and given a priestly gift to the vipra,
and then arranged a great festival, the observer of the vow should keep a night vigil. // 87

4.26.s:
kṛtvā vratopavāsaṃ ca yadi nidrāṃ niṣevate ..
punareva jalaṃ bhuṅkte vratārdhaphalabhāgbhavet .. 88 ..
4.26.d:
कृत्वा व्रतोपवासं च यदि निद्रां निषेवते ॥
पुनरेव जलं भुङ्क्ते व्रतार्धफलभाग्भवेत् ॥ 88 ॥
4.26.m:
If, having performed the fasting vow, one indulges in sleep,
or drinks water again, one partakes of only half the fruit of the vow. // 88

4.26.s:
yatnena ca haviṣyānnaṃ sakṛdeva samācaret ..
mantreṇānena viprendra śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇaṃ smaran .. 89 ..
4.26.d:
यत्नेन च हविष्यान्नं सकृदेव समाचरेत् ॥
मन्त्रेणानेन विप्रेन्द्र श्रीकृष्णचरणं स्मरन् ॥ 89 ॥
4.26.m:
And with effort one should consume sacrificial food only once,
with this mantra, O best of vipras, remembering the feet of Śrī Kṛṣṇa: // 89

4.26.s:
annaṃ hi prāṇināṃ prāṇā brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ purā ..
dehi me viṣṇurūpaṃ tvaṃ vratopavāsayoḥ phalam .. 4.26.90 ..
4.26.d:
अन्नं हि प्राणिनां प्राणा ब्रह्मणा निर्मितं पुरा ॥
देहि मे विष्णुरूपं त्वं व्रतोपवासयोः फलम् ॥ 4.26.90 ॥
4.26.m:
“Food is indeed the life-breath of living beings, fashioned in the beginning by Brahmā;
you, whose form is Viṣṇu, grant me the fruit of the vow and fast!” // 4.26.90

4.26.s:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā bhārate vratamuttamam ..
pūrvānsapta parānsapta svātmānamuddhareddhruvam ..91..
4.26.d:
एवं यः कुरुते भक्त्या भारते व्रतमुत्तमम् ॥
पूर्वान्सप्त परान्सप्त स्वात्मानमुद्धरेद्ध्रुवम् ॥91॥
4.26.m:
Whoever performs this supreme vow with devotion in Bhārata in this manner
surely delivers seven preceding [generations] and seven following, as well as himself. // 91

4.26.s:
mātaraṃ bhrātaraṃ caiva śvaśrūṃ ca śvaśuraṃ sutām ..
jāmātaraṃ tathā bhṛtyamuddharenniścitaṃ naraḥ .. 92 ..
4.26.d:
मातरं भ्रातरं चैव श्वश्रूं च श्वशुरं सुताम् ॥
जामातरं तथा भृत्यमुद्धरेन्निश्चितं नरः ॥ 92 ॥
4.26.m:
Mother and brother, mother-in-law, father-in-law, and daughter,
son-in-law, and likewise servant—a person definitely delivers [them all]. // 92

4.26.s:
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ vipra śrīkṛṣṇacaritavratam ..
sukhadaṃ mokṣadaṃ sāramaparaṃ kathayāmi te .. .. 93 ..
iti śrībrahmavavarte mahāpurāṇe śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe nārāyaṇanāradasaṃvāde ekādaśīvratanirūpaṇaṃ nāma ṣaḍviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 26 ..
4.26.d:
इत्येवं कथितं विप्र श्रीकृष्णचरितव्रतम् ॥
सुखदं मोक्षदं सारमपरं कथयामि ते ॥ ॥ 93 ॥
इति श्रीब्रह्मववर्ते महापुराणे श्रीकृष्णजन्मखण्डे नारायणनारदसंवादे एकादशीव्रतनिरूपणं नाम षड्विंशोऽध्यायः ॥ ॥ 26 ॥
4.26.m:
Thus the vow of the deeds of Śrī Kṛṣṇa has been told, O vipra,
which bestows happiness and liberation, the essential truth; I shall tell you another. // 93
Thus ends the twenty-sixth chapter, named “The Exposition of the Ekādaśī Vow,” in the dialogue between Nārāyaṇa and Nārada in the Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa of the glorious Brahmavaivarta Mahāpurāṇa. // 26

4.27.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
śṛṇu nārada vakṣyāmi śrīkṛṣṇacaritaṃ punaḥ ..
gopīnāṃ vastraharaṇaṃ varadānaṃ manīṣitam .. 1 ..
4.27.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
शृणु नारद वक्ष्यामि श्रीकृष्णचरितं पुनः ॥
गोपीनां वस्त्रहरणं वरदानं मनीषितम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.27.m: Śrī Nārāyaṇa said: / Listen, Nārada! I shall tell again the deed of Śrī Kṛṣṇa— / the stealing of the gopīs' garments and the granting of the desired boon. // 1 // / In the first month of the winter season, the gopikās, enchanted by love, / consuming sacrificial food with devotion throughout the month, self-restrained, // 2 // / having bathed on the bank of the daughter of the sun, having fashioned / Pārvatī out of sand and invoked her with mantras, performed worship daily, // 3 // / with delightful sandal, agallochum, musk, and saffron, / with diverse kinds of flowers and many kinds of garlands, // 4 // / with incense, lamps, food offerings, garments, various fruits, O sage, / with gems, pearls, coral, and diverse musical instruments. // 5 // / “O Goddess! O Mother of the worlds! O Creator, Sustainer, and Destroyer! / Grant us the son of the cowherd Nanda as our husband, O faithful lady!” // 6 // / Having recited this mantra to the Ruler of the gods, offering homage, / and having then made a formal resolve, they worshipped with the root mantra. // 7 // / The mantra, spoken in the Sāmaveda, potent and accompanied by seed-syllables, is: / “Oṃ, salutation to the glorious Durgā, the destroyer of all obstacles!” // 8 // / Flower, garland, food offering, incense, and auspicious lamp / they all offered with devotion through this mantra, filled with joy. // 9 // / Having recited this mantra a thousand times with devotion using a rosary of coral, / and having praised her, they bowed with their heads upon the earth: // 4.27.10 // / “O Most Auspicious of all auspicious things, O giver of all desires, O Śivā! / Grant me what is wished, O Goddess! Homage to you, beloved of Śaṅkara!” // 11 // / Having said this and bowed, and having given a priestly gift / and all the food offerings to the brāhmaṇas, they went home. // 12 // / Śrī Nārāyaṇa said: / Hear, O sage, the king of hymns by which all the cowherd women / praised Pārvatī with devotion, the giver of the fruit of all desired things! // 13 // / When the world was a dreadful single cosmic ocean, devoid of Rudras and suns, / and all that is moving and unmoving was flooded with collyrium-dark waters, // 14 // / it was given in the beginning to Brahmā by Hari, who reclines on the waters.

4.27.s:
hemante prathame māsi gopikāḥ kāmamohitāḥ ..
kṛtvā haviṣyaṃ bhaktyā ca yāvanmāsaṃ susaṃyutāḥ .. 2 ..
4.27.d:
हेमन्ते प्रथमे मासि गोपिकाः काममोहिताः ॥
कृत्वा हविष्यं भक्त्या च यावन्मासं सुसंयुताः ॥ 2 ॥

4.27.s:
snātvā sūryasutātīre pārvatīṃ vālukāmayīm ..
kṛtvā'vāhya ca mantreṇa pūjāṃ kurvanti nityaśaḥ .. 3 ..
4.27.d:
स्नात्वा सूर्यसुतातीरे पार्वतीं वालुकामयीम् ॥
कृत्वाऽवाह्य च मन्त्रेण पूजां कुर्वन्ति नित्यशः ॥ 3 ॥

4.27.s:
candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumaiśca manoharaiḥ ..
nānāprakārapuṣpaiśca mālyairbahuvidhairapi .. 4 ..
4.27.d:
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरीकुङ्कुमैश्च मनोहरैः ॥
नानाप्रकारपुष्पैश्च माल्यैर्बहुविधैरपि ॥ 4 ॥

4.27.s:
dhūpairdīpaiśca naivedyairvastrairnānāphalairmune ..
maṇimuktāpravālaiśca vādyairnānāvidhairapi .. 5 ..
4.27.d:
धूपैर्दीपैश्च नैवेद्यैर्वस्त्रैर्नानाफलैर्मुने ॥
मणिमुक्ताप्रवालैश्च वाद्यैर्नानाविधैरपि ॥ 5 ॥

4.27.s:
he devi jagatāṃ mātaḥ sṛṣṭisthityantakāriṇi ..
nandagopasutaṃ kāntamasmabhyaṃ dehi suvrate .. 6 ..
4.27.d:
हे देवि जगतां मातः सृष्टिस्थित्यन्तकारिणि ॥
नन्दगोपसुतं कान्तमस्मभ्यं देहि सुव्रते ॥ 6 ॥

4.27.s:
mantreṇānena deveśīṃ parihāraṃ vidhāya ca ..
tataḥ kṛtvā tu saṃkalpaṃ pūjayan mūlamantrataḥ .. 7 ..
4.27.d:
मन्त्रेणानेन देवेशीं परिहारं विधाय च ॥
ततः कृत्वा तु संकल्पं पूजयन् मूलमन्त्रतः ॥ 7 ॥

4.27.s:
mantrastu sāmavedokto'yātayāmaḥ sabījakaḥ ..
oṃ śrīdurgāyai sarvavighnavināśinyai nama iti ..8 ..
4.27.d:
मन्त्रस्तु सामवेदोक्तोऽयातयामः सबीजकः ॥
ओं श्रीदुर्गायै सर्वविघ्नविनाशिन्यै नम इति ॥8 ॥

4.27.s:
puṣpaṃ mālyaṃ ca naivedyaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ tathā śubham ..
mantreṇānena tadbhaktyā daduḥ sarvā mudānvitāḥ .. 9 ..
4.27.d:
पुष्पं माल्यं च नैवेद्यं धूपं दीपं तथा शुभम् ॥
मन्त्रेणानेन तद्भक्त्या ददुः सर्वा मुदान्विताः ॥ 9 ॥

4.27.s:
pravālamālayā bhaktyā cemaṃ mantraṃ sahasradhā ..
japaṃ kṛtvā ca stutvā ca praṇemuḥ śirasā bhuvi .. 4.27.10 ..
4.27.d:
प्रवालमालया भक्त्या चेमं मन्त्रं सहस्रधा ॥
जपं कृत्वा च स्तुत्वा च प्रणेमुः शिरसा भुवि ॥ 4.27.10 ॥

4.27.s:
sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalye sarvakāmaprade śive ..
dehi me vāñchitaṃ devi namaste śaṃkarapriye .. 11 ..
4.27.d:
सर्वमङ्गलमाङ्गल्ये सर्वकामप्रदे शिवे ॥
देहि मे वाञ्छितं देवि नमस्ते शंकरप्रिये ॥ 11 ॥

4.27.s:
ityuktvā ca namaskāraṃ kṛtvā dattvā ca dakṣiṇām..
naivedyāni ca sarvāṇi brāhmaṇebhyo yayurgṛham .. 12 ..
4.27.d:
इत्युक्त्वा च नमस्कारं कृत्वा दत्त्वा च दक्षिणाम्॥
नैवेद्यानि च सर्वाणि ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ययुर्गृहम् ॥ 12 ॥

4.27.s:
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca ..
stavarājaṃ śṛṇu mune tuṣṭuvuryena pārvatīm ..
bhaktyā gopāṅganāḥ sarvāḥ sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradām .. 13 ..
4.27.d:
श्रीनारायण उवाच ॥
स्तवराजं शृणु मुने तुष्टुवुर्येन पार्वतीम् ॥
भक्त्या गोपाङ्गनाः सर्वाः सर्वाभीष्टफलप्रदाम् ॥ 13 ॥

4.27.s:
jagatyekārṇave ghore rudrasūryavivarjite ..
añjanākāratoyena saṃplute ca carācare .. 14 ..
4.27.d:
जगत्येकार्णवे घोरे रुद्रसूर्यविवर्जिते ॥
अञ्जनाकारतोयेन संप्लुते च चराचरे ॥ 14 ॥

4.27.s:
dattaṃ purā brahmaṇe ca hariṇā jalaśāyinā ..
tasmai dattvā sarvamidaṃ nidrāṃ bheje jagatpatiḥ .. 15 ..
4.27.d:
दत्तं पुरा ब्रह्मणे च हरिणा जलशायिना ॥
तस्मै दत्त्वा सर्वमिदं निद्रां भेजे जगत्पतिः ॥ 15 ॥
4.27.m: Having given all this to him, the Lord of the world went to sleep. // 15 // / On the navel-lotus, the Creator of the world, tormented by Madhu / and Kaiṭabha, praised the Supreme Sovereign Lady, the Mūlaprakṛti. // 16 // / Brahmā said: / “O Durgā! O Śivā! O Fearless One! O Māyā! O Nārāyaṇī! O Eternal One! / O Jayā! Grant me auspiciousness! Homage to you, All-Auspicious One! // 17 // / The syllable da is stated to express the destruction of demons; / the syllable u expresses the destruction of obstacles, approved by the Vedas; // 18 // / the letter r expresses the destruction of disease, and ga expresses the destruction of sin; / the syllable ā is declared to express the destruction of fear and enemies. // 19 // / By the recollection of the utterance of whose memory these surely perish; / therefore she, the śakti of Hari, is praised as Durgā by Hari. // 4.27.20 // / Durga expresses misfortune, and the syllable ā expresses destruction; / she who perpetually destroys misfortune is praised as Durgā. // 21 // / Durga expresses the demon king, and the syllable ā expresses destruction; / she destroyed him of old; therefore she is celebrated as Durgā by the wise. // 22 // / The syllable śa expresses prosperity, and the syllable i expresses excellence; / the syllable va expresses a host, and the syllable ā expresses the giver. // 23 // / As the giver of excellence and hosts of blessings, she is praised as Śivā; / as the embodied heap of auspiciousness, she is praised as Śivā. // 24 // / Śiva indeed expresses liberation, and the syllable ā expresses the giver; / she who herself bestows nirvāṇa is praised as Śivā. // 25 // / Abhaya is spoken of as the destruction of fear, and the syllable ā expresses the giver; / she gives fearlessness instantly; she is praised as Abhayā. // 26 // / The syllable mā expresses regal fortune, and yā expresses the bringing [of it]; / she who brings that instantly is praised as Māyā. // 27 // / The syllable mā expresses the goal of liberation, and yā expresses the bringing [of it]; / she who constantly brings that is praised as Māyā. // 28 // / Constituting half the body of Nārāyaṇa, and equal to him in splendour, / she is ever situated in his body; therefore she is remembered as Nārāyaṇī. // 29 // / Sanātana expresses the attributeless and eternal...

4.27.s:
nābhipadme jagatsraṣṭā madhunā kaiṭabhena ca ..
pīḍitaḥ parituṣṭāva mūlaprakṛtimīśvarīm .. 16 ..
4.27.d:
नाभिपद्मे जगत्स्रष्टा मधुना कैटभेन च ॥
पीडितः परितुष्टाव मूलप्रकृतिमीश्वरीम् ॥ 16 ॥

4.27.s:
brahmovāca ..
durge śive'bhaye māye nārāyaṇi sanātani ..
jaye me maṅgalaṃ dehi namaste sarvamaṅgale .. 17 ..
4.27.d:
ब्रह्मोवाच ॥
दुर्गे शिवेऽभये माये नारायणि सनातनि ॥
जये मे मङ्गलं देहि नमस्ते सर्वमङ्गले ॥ 17 ॥

4.27.s:
daityanāśārthavacano dakāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ ..
ukāro vighnanāśārthaṃ vācako vedasaṃmataḥ .. 18 ..
4.27.d:
दैत्यनाशार्थवचनो दकारः परिकीर्तितः ॥
उकारो विघ्ननाशार्थं वाचको वेदसंमतः ॥ 18 ॥

4.27.s:
repho rogaghnavacano gaśca pāpaghnavācakaḥ ..
bhayaśatrughnavacanaścākāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ .. 19 ..
4.27.d:
रेफो रोगघ्नवचनो गश्च पापघ्नवाचकः ॥
भयशत्रुघ्नवचनश्चाकारः परिकीर्तितः ॥ 19 ॥

4.27.s:
smṛtyukti smaraṇādyasyā ete naśyanti niścitam ..
ato durgā hareḥ śaktirhariṇā parikīrtitā .. 4.27.20 ..
4.27.d:
स्मृत्युक्ति स्मरणाद्यस्या एते नश्यन्ति निश्चितम् ॥
अतो दुर्गा हरेः शक्तिर्हरिणा परिकीर्तिता ॥ 4.27.20 ॥

4.27.s:
vipattivācako durgaścākāro nāśavācakaḥ ..
durgaṃ naśyati yā nityaṃ sā durgā parikīrtitā... 21 ..
4.27.d:
विपत्तिवाचको दुर्गश्चाकारो नाशवाचकः ॥
दुर्गं नश्यति या नित्यं सा दुर्गा परिकीर्तिता॥। 21 ॥

4.27.s:
durgo daityendravacano'pyākāro nāśavācakaḥ ..
taṃ nanāśa purā tena budhairdurgā prakīrtitā .. 22 ..
4.27.d:
दुर्गो दैत्येन्द्रवचनोऽप्याकारो नाशवाचकः ॥
तं ननाश पुरा तेन बुधैर्दुर्गा प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 22 ॥

4.27.s:
śaśca kalyāṇavacana ikārotkṛṣṭavācakaḥ ..
samūhavācakaścaiva vākāro dātṛvācakaḥ .. 23 ..
4.27.d:
शश्च कल्याणवचन इकारोत्कृष्टवाचकः ॥
समूहवाचकश्चैव वाकारो दातृवाचकः ॥ 23 ॥

4.27.s:
śreyaḥsaṅghotkṛṣṭadātrī śivā tena prakīrtitā ..
śivarāśirmūrttimatī śivā tena prakīrtitā .. 24 ..
4.27.d:
श्रेयःसङ्घोत्कृष्टदात्री शिवा तेन प्रकीर्तिता ॥
शिवराशिर्मूर्त्तिमती शिवा तेन प्रकीर्तिता ॥ 24 ॥

4.27.s:
śivo hi mokṣavacanaścākāro dātṛvācakaḥ ..
svayaṃ nirvāṇadātrī yā sā śivā parikīrtitā .. 25 ..
4.27.d:
शिवो हि मोक्षवचनश्चाकारो दातृवाचकः ॥
स्वयं निर्वाणदात्री या सा शिवा परिकीर्तिता ॥ 25 ॥

4.27.s:
abhayo bhayanāśoktaścākāro dātṛvācakaḥ ..
pradadātyabhayaṃ sadyaḥ sā'bhayā parikīrtitā .. 26 ..
4.27.d:
अभयो भयनाशोक्तश्चाकारो दातृवाचकः ॥
प्रददात्यभयं सद्यः साऽभया परिकीर्तिता ॥ 26 ॥

4.27.s:
rājyaśrīvacano māśca yāśca prāpaṇavācakaḥ ..
tāṃ prāpayati yā sadyaḥ sā māyā parikīrtitā .. 27 ..
4.27.d:
राज्यश्रीवचनो माश्च याश्च प्रापणवाचकः ॥
तां प्रापयति या सद्यः सा माया परिकीर्तिता ॥ 27 ॥

4.27.s:
māśca mokṣārthavacano yāśca prāpaṇavācakaḥ ..
taṃ prāpayati yā nityaṃ sā māyā parikīrtitā..28..
4.27.d:
माश्च मोक्षार्थवचनो याश्च प्रापणवाचकः ॥
तं प्रापयति या नित्यं सा माया परिकीर्तिता॥28॥

4.27.s:
nārāyaṇārdhāṅgabhūtā tena tulyā ca tejasā..
sadā tasya śarīrasthā tena nārāyaṇī smṛtā ..29 ..
4.27.d:
नारायणार्धाङ्गभूता तेन तुल्या च तेजसा॥
सदा तस्य शरीरस्था तेन नारायणी स्मृता ॥29 ॥

4.27.s:
nirguṇasya ca nityasya vācakaśca sanātanaḥ ..
sadā nityā nirguṇā yā kīrtitā sā sanātanī .. 4.27.30 ..
4.27.d:
निर्गुणस्य च नित्यस्य वाचकश्च सनातनः ॥
सदा नित्या निर्गुणा या कीर्तिता सा सनातनी ॥ 4.27.30 ॥

4.27.s:
jayaḥ kalyāṇavacano yākāro dātṛvācakaḥ ..
jayaṃ dadāti yā nityaṃ sā jayā parikīrtitā .. 31 ..
4.27.d:
जयः कल्याणवचनो याकारो दातृवाचकः ॥
जयं ददाति या नित्यं सा जया परिकीर्तिता ॥ 31 ॥

4.27.s:
sarva maṅgalaśabdaśca saṃpūṇaiśvaryavācakaḥ ..
ākāro dātṛvacanastaddātrī sarvamaṅgalā ..32..
4.27.d:
सर्व मङ्गलशब्दश्च संपूणैश्वर्यवाचकः ॥
आकारो दातृवचनस्तद्दात्री सर्वमङ्गला ॥32॥

4.27.s:
nāmāṣṭakamidaṃ sāraṃ nāmārthasahasaṃyutam ..
nārāyaṇena yaddattaṃ brahmaṇe nābhipaṅkaje .. 33 ..
4.27.d:
नामाष्टकमिदं सारं नामार्थसहसंयुतम् ॥
नारायणेन यद्दत्तं ब्रह्मणे नाभिपङ्कजे ॥ 33 ॥

4.27.s:
tasmai dattvā nidritaśca babhūva jagatāṃ patiḥ ..
madhukaiṭabhau durgāṃ tau brahmāṇaṃ hantumudyatau .. 34 ..
4.27.d:
तस्मै दत्त्वा निद्रितश्च बभूव जगतां पतिः ॥
मधुकैटभौ दुर्गां तौ ब्रह्माणं हन्तुमुद्यतौ ॥ 34 ॥

4.27.s:
stotreṇānena sa brahmā stutiṃ natvā cakāra ha ..
sākṣātstutā tadā durgā brahmaṇe kavacaṃ dadau .. 35 ..
4.27.d:
स्तोत्रेणानेन स ब्रह्मा स्तुतिं नत्वा चकार ह ॥
साक्षात्स्तुता तदा दुर्गा ब्रह्मणे कवचं ददौ ॥ 35 ॥

4.27.s:
śrīkṛṣṇakavacaṃ divyaṃ sarvarakṣaṇanāmakam ..
dattvā tasmai mahāmāyā sā'ntardhānaṃ cakāra ha .. 36 ..
4.27.d:
श्रीकृष्णकवचं दिव्यं सर्वरक्षणनामकम् ॥
दत्त्वा तस्मै महामाया साऽन्तर्धानं चकार ह ॥ 36 ॥

4.27.s:
stotraṃ kurvanti nidrāṃ ca saṃrakṣya kavacena vai ..
nidrānugrahataḥ sadyaḥ stotrasyaiva prabhāvataḥ .. 37 ..
4.27.d:
स्तोत्रं कुर्वन्ति निद्रां च संरक्ष्य कवचेन वै ॥
निद्रानुग्रहतः सद्यः स्तोत्रस्यैव प्रभावतः ॥ 37 ॥

4.27.s:
tatrājagāma bhagavānvṛṣarūpī janārdanaḥ ..
śaktyā ca durgayā sārdhaṃ śaṃkarasya jayāya ca .. 38 ..
4.27.d:
तत्राजगाम भगवान्वृषरूपी जनार्दनः ॥
शक्त्या च दुर्गया सार्धं शंकरस्य जयाय च ॥ 38 ॥

4.27.s:
sarathaṃ śaṃkaraṃ mūrdhni kṛtvā ca nirbhayaṃ dadau..
atyūrdhvaṃ prāpayāmāsa jayā tasmai jayaṃ dadau .. 39 ..
4.27.d:
सरथं शंकरं मूर्ध्नि कृत्वा च निर्भयं ददौ॥
अत्यूर्ध्वं प्रापयामास जया तस्मै जयं ददौ ॥ 39 ॥

4.27.s:
stotrasyaiva prabhāveṇa saṃprāpya kavacaṃ vidhiḥ ..
varaṃ ca kavacaṃ prāpya nirbhayaṃ prāpa niścitam .. 4.27.40 ..
4.27.d:
स्तोत्रस्यैव प्रभावेण संप्राप्य कवचं विधिः ॥
वरं च कवचं प्राप्य निर्भयं प्राप निश्चितम् ॥ 4.27.40 ॥

4.27.s:
brahmā dadau maheśāya stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ varam..
tripurasya ca saṃgrāme sarathe patite harau .. 41 ..
4.27.d:
ब्रह्मा ददौ महेशाय स्तोत्रं च कवचं वरम्॥
त्रिपुरस्य च संग्रामे सरथे पतिते हरौ ॥ 41 ॥

4.27.s:
brahmāstraṃ ca gṛhītvā sa sanidraṃ śrīhariṃ smaran ..
stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ prāpya jaghāna tripuraṃ haraḥ .. 42 ..
4.27.d:
ब्रह्मास्त्रं च गृहीत्वा स सनिद्रं श्रीहरिं स्मरन् ॥
स्तोत्रं च कवचं प्राप्य जघान त्रिपुरं हरः ॥ 42 ॥

4.27.s:
stotreṇānena tāṃ durgāṃ kṛtvā gopālikā stutim..
lebhire śrīhariṃ kāntaṃ stotrasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ..43..
4.27.d:
स्तोत्रेणानेन तां दुर्गां कृत्वा गोपालिका स्तुतिम्॥
लेभिरे श्रीहरिं कान्तं स्तोत्रस्यास्य प्रभावतः ॥43॥

4.27.s:
gopakanyā kṛtaṃ stotraṃ sarvamaṅgalanāmakam ..
vāṃchitārthapradaṃ sadyaḥ sarvavighnavināśanam .. 44 ..
4.27.d:
गोपकन्या कृतं स्तोत्रं सर्वमङ्गलनामकम् ॥
वांछितार्थप्रदं सद्यः सर्वविघ्नविनाशनम् ॥ 44 ॥
4.27.m:
She who is eternal and devoid of the gunas is celebrated as Sanātanī.
The word 'jaya' means auspiciousness, and the letter 'yā' means the giver;
she who bestows victory constantly is proclaimed as Jayā.
The word 'sarvamaṅgala' denotes complete majesty and power;
the letter 'ā' means the giver, [hence] the giver of that is Sarvamaṅgalā.
This essential set of eight names, accompanied by the meanings of those names,
was given by Nārāyaṇa to Brahmā on the lotus of his navel.
Having given [it] to him, the Lord of the worlds fell asleep.
When Madhu and Kaiṭabha rose up, prepared to kill Brahmā,
Brahmā bowed and praised Durgā with this hymn of praise.
Directly praised then, Durgā gave Brahmā an armour,
the divine Śrīkṛṣṇa-armour named Sarvarakṣaṇa ('All-Protecting').
Having given it to him, Mahāmāyā vanished from sight.
They perform the hymn of praise, and having protected sleep with the armour,
by the grace of Sleep and by the very power of the hymn of praise,
the Lord Janārdana came there in the form of a bull,
along with his potency Durgā, for the victory of Śaṅkara.
Placing Śaṅkara along with his chariot on his head, he made him fearless;
he lifted him very high, and Jayā granted him victory.
By the power of this very hymn of praise Brahmā obtained the armour;
having obtained the boon and the armour, he indeed attained fearlessness.
Brahmā gave the excellent hymn of praise and the armour to Maheśa;
and in the battle with Tripura, when Śiva along with his chariot fell,
he took up the Brahmā weapon, remembering the sleeping Śrī Hari;
receiving the hymn of praise and the armour, Hara slew Tripura.
Praising Durgā with this hymn of praise, the cowherd maidens
obtained Śrī Hari as their beloved by the power of this hymn of praise.
This hymn of praise composed by the cowherd maidens is called Sarvamaṅgalā.
It immediately grants desired objectives and destroys all obstacles.
Whatever person reads it daily at the three twilight junctions with devotion,
whether a Śaiva, a Vaiṣṇava, or a Śākta, is freed from danger.
At the king's gate, in the cremation ground, in a forest fire, when life is in peril,
when seized by fear of predatory beasts, or when sinking in a ship upon the great ocean;
when besieged by enemies, in battle, in prison, or fallen into misfortune;
under the curse of a guru, the curse of a brahmin, or in irremediable separation from kinsmen;
when fallen from one's place, stripped of wealth, cast out of caste, or afflicted with grief;
separated from a husband, separated from a son, or afflicted with the poison of a wicked serpent—
by the mere remembrance of this hymn of praise, one is instantly freed, devoid of fear.
One immediately attains one's desire and unsurpassable universal sovereignty;
in this world, firm devotion to Hari and constant remembrance of him;
and in the end, one attains servitude [to him] by the grace of Pārvatī.
Thus ends the Sarvamaṅgalā Hymn of Praise composed by the cowherd maidens in the Śrī Brahmavaivarta.
With this king of hymns of praise, the women of Vraja praised the Goddess daily
and bowed down with supreme devotion throughout the month.
Thus, when the month was completed, on the final day,
the cowherd maidens went to bathe, leaving their garments on the riverbank,
along with various articles of gem-like value, O Nārada,
yellow, red, and white, beautiful and multicoloured,
innumerable [items] covering the bank, and by them the bank was made very splendid;
it was made fragrant by the breeze carrying sandalwood, agallochum, and musk,
and adorned with offerings of various kinds, fruits produced according to time and place,
incense, lamps, vermilion, and saffron.
Eager to play in the water, the cowherd maidens became full of delight;
naked and absorbed in their games, their minds were surrendered to Śrī Kṛṣṇa.
Seeing the garments and various articles, Kṛṣṇa
took the clothes and the articles, and ate [the offerings] together with the boys.
Going far away, all the cowherd boys stood, filled with joy.

4.27.s:
trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennityaṃ bhaktiyuktaśca mānavaḥ..
śaivo vā vaiṣṇavo vā'pi śākto durgātpramucyate ..45..
4.27.d:
त्रिसन्ध्यं यः पठेन्नित्यं भक्तियुक्तश्च मानवः॥
शैवो वा वैष्णवो वाऽपि शाक्तो दुर्गात्प्रमुच्यते ॥45॥

4.27.s:
rājadvāre śmaśāne ca dāvāgnau prāṇasaṃkaṭe ..
hiṃsrajantubhayagrasto magnaḥ pote mahārṇave ..46..
4.27.d:
राजद्वारे श्मशाने च दावाग्नौ प्राणसंकटे ॥
हिंस्रजन्तुभयग्रस्तो मग्नः पोते महार्णवे ॥46॥

4.27.s:
śatrugraste ca saṃgrāme kārāgāre vipadgate ..
guruśāpe brahmaśāpe bandhubhede ca dustare ..47..
4.27.d:
शत्रुग्रस्ते च संग्रामे कारागारे विपद्गते ॥
गुरुशापे ब्रह्मशापे बन्धुभेदे च दुस्तरे ॥47॥

4.27.s:
sthānabhraṣṭe dhanabhraṣṭe jātibhraṣṭe śucā'nvite ..
patibhede putrabhede khalasarpaviṣānvite ..48..
4.27.d:
स्थानभ्रष्टे धनभ्रष्टे जातिभ्रष्टे शुचाऽन्विते ॥
पतिभेदे पुत्रभेदे खलसर्पविषान्विते ॥48॥

4.27.s:
stotrasmaraṇamātreṇa sadyo mucyeta nirbhayaḥ ..
vāṃchitaṃ labhate sadyaḥ sarvaiśvaryamanuttamam .. 49 ..
4.27.d:
स्तोत्रस्मरणमात्रेण सद्यो मुच्येत निर्भयः ॥
वांछितं लभते सद्यः सर्वैश्वर्यमनुत्तमम् ॥ 49 ॥

4.27.s:
iha loke harerbhaktiṃ dṛḍhāṃ ca satataṃ smṛtim ..
ante dāsyaṃ ca labhate pārvatyāśca prasādataḥ..4.27.50..
4.27.d:
इह लोके हरेर्भक्तिं दृढां च सततं स्मृतिम् ॥
अन्ते दास्यं च लभते पार्वत्याश्च प्रसादतः॥4.27.50॥

4.27.s:
iti śrībrahmavaivarte gopakanyākṛtaṃ sarvamaṃgalāstotram ..
anena stavarājena tuṣṭuvurnityamīśvarīm ..
praṇemuḥ parayā bhaktyā yāvanmāsaṃ vrajāṅganāḥ .. 51 ..
4.27.d:
इति श्रीब्रह्मवैवर्ते गोपकन्याकृतं सर्वमंगलास्तोत्रम् ॥
अनेन स्तवराजेन तुष्टुवुर्नित्यमीश्वरीम् ॥
प्रणेमुः परया भक्त्या यावन्मासं व्रजाङ्गनाः ॥ 51 ॥

4.27.s:
evaṃ pūrṇe ca māse ca samāptidivase tathā ..
snātuṃ prajagmurgopyaśca vastrāṇyādhāya tattaṭe ..52..
4.27.d:
एवं पूर्णे च मासे च समाप्तिदिवसे तथा ॥
स्नातुं प्रजग्मुर्गोप्यश्च वस्त्राण्याधाय तत्तटे ॥52॥

4.27.s:
nānāvidhāni dravyāṇi ratnamūlyāni nārada ..
pītalohitaśuklāni cārūṇi miśritāni ca .. 53 ..
4.27.d:
नानाविधानि द्रव्याणि रत्नमूल्यानि नारद ॥
पीतलोहितशुक्लानि चारूणि मिश्रितानि च ॥ 53 ॥

4.27.s:
tīrāvṛtānyasaṃkhyāni taiśca tīraṃ suśobhanam ..
candanāgurukastūrī vāyunā surabhīkṛtam ..54..
4.27.d:
तीरावृतान्यसंख्यानि तैश्च तीरं सुशोभनम् ॥
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरी वायुना सुरभीकृतम् ॥54॥

4.27.s:
naivedyaiśca bahuvidhaiḥ kāladeśodbhavaiḥ phalaiḥ ..
dhūpaiḥ pradīpaiḥ sindūraiḥ kuṅkumaiśca virājitam .. 55 ..
4.27.d:
नैवेद्यैश्च बहुविधैः कालदेशोद्भवैः फलैः ॥
धूपैः प्रदीपैः सिन्दूरैः कुङ्कुमैश्च विराजितम् ॥ 55 ॥

4.27.s:
jale krīḍonmukhā gopyo babhūvuḥ kautukena ca ..
nagnāḥ krīḍābhirāsaktāḥ śrīkṛṣṇārpitamānasāḥ .. 56 ..
4.27.d:
जले क्रीडोन्मुखा गोप्यो बभूवुः कौतुकेन च ॥
नग्नाः क्रीडाभिरासक्ताः श्रीकृष्णार्पितमानसाः ॥ 56 ॥

4.27.s:
dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaśca vastrāṇi dravyāṇi vividhāni ca ..
vāsāṃsyādāya vastūni cakhāda śiśubhiḥ saha ..57..
4.27.d:
दृष्ट्वा कृष्णश्च वस्त्राणि द्रव्याणि विविधानि च ॥
वासांस्यादाय वस्तूनि चखाद शिशुभिः सह ॥57॥

4.27.s:
gatvā dūraṃ ca gopālāstasthuḥ sarve mudā'nvitāḥ..
vastrāṇi puṃjīkṛtyādāvūcuḥ skandhe'tilolupāḥ .. 58 ..
4.27.d:
गत्वा दूरं च गोपालास्तस्थुः सर्वे मुदाऽन्विताः॥
वस्त्राणि पुंजीकृत्यादावूचुः स्कन्धेऽतिलोलुपाः ॥ 58 ॥

4.27.s:
śrīdāmā ca sudāmā ca vasudāmā tathaiva ca ..
subalaśca supārśvaśca śubhāṅgaḥ sundarastathā .. 59 ..
4.27.d:
श्रीदामा च सुदामा च वसुदामा तथैव च ॥
सुबलश्च सुपार्श्वश्च शुभाङ्गः सुन्दरस्तथा ॥ 59 ॥

4.27.s:
candrabhāno vīrabhānaḥ sūryabhānastathaiva ca ..
vasubhāno ratnabhāno gopālā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ .. 4.27.60 ..
4.27.d:
चन्द्रभानो वीरभानः सूर्यभानस्तथैव च ॥
वसुभानो रत्नभानो गोपाला द्वादश स्मृताः ॥ 4.27.60 ॥

4.27.s:
śrīkṛṣṇo baladevaśca pradhānāśca caturdaśa ..
gopā harervayasyāśca koṭiśaḥ koṭiśo mune .. 61 ..
4.27.d:
श्रीकृष्णो बलदेवश्च प्रधानाश्च चतुर्दश ॥
गोपा हरेर्वयस्याश्च कोटिशः कोटिशो मुने ॥ 61 ॥

4.27.s:
vastrāṇyādāya te sarve tasthurekatra dūrataḥ ..
śataśaḥ puñjikāstatra sthāpayāmāsurunmukhāḥ .. 62 ..
4.27.d:
वस्त्राण्यादाय ते सर्वे तस्थुरेकत्र दूरतः ॥
शतशः पुञ्जिकास्तत्र स्थापयामासुरुन्मुखाः ॥ 62 ॥

4.27.s:
kiṃcidvastraṃ samādāya kṛtvā ca puñjikāṃ mudā ..
samāruhya kadambāgramuvāca gopikā hariḥ .. 63 ..
4.27.d:
किंचिद्वस्त्रं समादाय कृत्वा च पुञ्जिकां मुदा ॥
समारुह्य कदम्बाग्रमुवाच गोपिका हरिः ॥ 63 ॥

4.27.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
bhobho gopālikāḥ sarvā vinaṣṭā vratakarmaṇi ..
kṛtvā vidhānaṃ madvākyaṃ śrutvā krīḍata manmathāt .. 64 ..
4.27.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
भोभो गोपालिकाः सर्वा विनष्टा व्रतकर्मणि ॥
कृत्वा विधानं मद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा क्रीडत मन्मथात् ॥ 64 ॥

4.27.s:
saṃkalpite vratārhe ca māse maṅgalakarmaṇi ..
yūyaṃ nagnāḥ kathaṃ toye vratāṅgahānikārikāḥ .. 65 ..
4.27.d:
संकल्पिते व्रतार्हे च मासे मङ्गलकर्मणि ॥
यूयं नग्नाः कथं तोये व्रताङ्गहानिकारिकाः ॥ 65 ॥

4.27.s:
paridheyāni vāsāṃsi puṣpamālyāni yāni ca ..
vratārhāṇi ca vastūni kena nītāni vo'dhunā .. 66 ..
4.27.d:
परिधेयानि वासांसि पुष्पमाल्यानि यानि च ॥
व्रतार्हाणि च वस्तूनि केन नीतानि वोऽधुना ॥ 66 ॥

4.27.s:
vrate tu nagnā yā snāti tāṃ ruṣṭo varuṇaḥ svayam..
varuṇānucarāścakrurvāsovastūpanirhṛtim .. 67 ..
4.27.d:
व्रते तु नग्ना या स्नाति तां रुष्टो वरुणः स्वयम्॥
वरुणानुचराश्चक्रुर्वासोवस्तूपनिर्हृतिम् ॥ 67 ॥

4.27.s:
kathaṃ yāsyatha nagnāśca na vratasyā bhaviṣyati..
vratārādhyā kathaṃ sā ca vastūni kiṃ na rakṣati ..68..
4.27.d:
कथं यास्यथ नग्नाश्च न व्रतस्या भविष्यति॥
व्रताराध्या कथं सा च वस्तूनि किं न रक्षति ॥68॥

4.27.s:
cintāṃ kuruta tāṃ pūjyāṃ tuṣṭāva balirīśvarīm ..
yuṣmākamīdṛśī devī na śaktā vasturakṣaṇe .. 69 ..
4.27.d:
चिन्तां कुरुत तां पूज्यां तुष्टाव बलिरीश्वरीम् ॥
युष्माकमीदृशी देवी न शक्ता वस्तुरक्षणे ॥ 69 ॥

4.27.s:
kathaṃ vrataphalaṃ sā vā dātuṃ śaktā sureśvarī ..
phalaṃ pradātuṃ yā śaktā sā śaktā sarvakarmaṇi .. 4.27.70 ..
4.27.d:
कथं व्रतफलं सा वा दातुं शक्ता सुरेश्वरी ॥
फलं प्रदातुं या शक्ता सा शक्ता सर्वकर्मणि ॥ 4.27.70 ॥

4.27.s:
śrīkṛṣṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā cintāmāpurvrajastriyaḥ ..
dadṛśuryamunātīraṃ vastravastuvihīnakam ..71..
4.27.d:
श्रीकृष्णस्य वचः श्रुत्वा चिन्तामापुर्व्रजस्त्रियः ॥
ददृशुर्यमुनातीरं वस्त्रवस्तुविहीनकम् ॥71॥

4.27.s:
cakrurviṣādaṃ toye ca nagnāstā rurudurbhṛśam ..
kva gatāni ca vastrāṇi vastūnītyūcuratra naḥ .. 72 ..
4.27.d:
चक्रुर्विषादं तोये च नग्नास्ता रुरुदुर्भृशम् ॥
क्व गतानि च वस्त्राणि वस्तूनीत्यूचुरत्र नः ॥ 72 ॥
4.27.m:
Having first piled up the clothes, they placed them on their shoulders, highly eager:
Śrīdāman, Sudāman, and likewise Vasudāman,
Subala, Supārśva, Śubhāṅga, and Sundara,
Candrabhānu, Vīrabhānu, and likewise Sūryabhānu,
Vasubhānu, and Ratnabhānu—these are remembered as the twelve cowherds.
Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Baladeva make fourteen principal ones;
and the cowherd companions of Hari, O sage, were in millions and millions.
Taking the clothes, they all stood together at a distance;
eagerly they set down hundreds of bundles there.
Taking some garments and joyfully making a bundle,
Hari climbed to the top of a kadamba tree and spoke to the cowherd maidens:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
"O cowherd maidens, all of you have ruined your vow!
Perform the rite according to my word, and having heard it, play out of desire!
During this month intended for the undertaking of a vow, in an auspicious rite,
why are you naked in the water, causing injury to a part of your vow?
Who has now carried off your wearable garments,
your flower garlands, and the articles proper for the vow?
Varuṇa himself is angered with her who bathes naked during a vow;
Varuṇa's attendants have carried off the garments and articles!
How will you go [home] naked? Your vow will bear no fruit.
Why does she, the goddess worshipped in the vow, not protect your articles?
Think upon that worthy object of worship; Bali once praised that Goddess.
Such a goddess of yours is not able to protect your goods!
How is that queen of the gods able to grant the fruit of the vow?
She who is able to grant the fruit is able in all actions."
Hearing the words of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the women of Vraja were filled with anxiety;
they saw the bank of the Yamunā bereft of clothes and articles.
Naked in the water, they fell into despondency and wept bitterly;
"Where have our garments and articles gone from here?" they said.

4.27.s:
kṛtvā viṣādaṃ tatraiva tamūcurgopakanyakāḥ ..
puṭāñjaliyutāḥ sarvā bhaktyā vinayapūrvakam ..73 ..
4.27.d:
कृत्वा विषादं तत्रैव तमूचुर्गोपकन्यकाः ॥
पुटाञ्जलियुताः सर्वा भक्त्या विनयपूर्वकम् ॥73 ॥
4.27.m: Grieving right there, the cowherd maidens, / all joining their hands in reverent greeting, addressed him with devotion and humility: / The cowherd maidens said: / "These garments are to be worn by your handmaidens, eternal Lord! / Understand yourself: is it fitting for you to touch them? / And things meant for a vow, belonging to the gods now, / are not to be given away or snatched—O knower of the Vedas, speak! / Give us the washed clothes; we shall put them on and perform our vow. / Govinda, eat your food with some other dish!" / Meanwhile, Śrīdāman, showing the bundle of clothes to all of them, / ran far off in front of them. / Seeing the cowherd with the garments, the supreme sovereign of all, / submerged in the water, spoke angrily to all her companions: / Śrī Rādhikā said: / "O Suśīlā, Śaśikalā, O Candramukhī, Mādhavī, / Kadambamālā, O Kuntī, Yamunā, Sarvamaṅgalā, / O Padmamukhī, Sāvitrī, Pārijātā, and Jāhnavī, / Sudhāmukhī, Śubhā, Padmā, O Gaurī, O Svayaṃprabhā, / Kālikā, Kamalā, Durgā, O Sarasvatī, Bhāratī, / Apūrṇā, Rati, O Gaṅgā, and Ambikā, virtuous Sundarī, / Kṛṣṇapriyā, Madhumatī, Campā, Candananandinī— / all of you rise, bind the cowherd, and bring him here!" / At Rādhā's command, all the cowherd maidens quickly rose from the water in fury / and set out naked, covering their vulvas with their hands. / Their companion cowherdesses in the thousands quickly / set out in that manner, their eyes reddened with rage. / All the maidens rushed swiftly after Śrīdāman, / who was running with speed carrying the bundle of garments. / Śrīdāman went swiftly to where the cowherd boys were with the clothes; / the cowherdesses rushed swiftly behind him with full force. / Quickly they surrounded the cowherds, the thieves of their garments.

4.27.s:
gopālikā ūcuḥ ..
paridheyāni vastrāṇi kiṃkarīṇāṃ sadīśvara ..
nibodhayātmānameva sparśaṃ kartuṃ tvamarhasi .. 74 ..
4.27.d:
गोपालिका ऊचुः ॥
परिधेयानि वस्त्राणि किंकरीणां सदीश्वर ॥
निबोधयात्मानमेव स्पर्शं कर्तुं त्वमर्हसि ॥ 74 ॥

4.27.s:
vratārhāṇi ca vastūni devasvāni ca sāmpratam ..
adattāni mocitāni grahītuṃ vedavidvada ..75..
4.27.d:
व्रतार्हाणि च वस्तूनि देवस्वानि च साम्प्रतम् ॥
अदत्तानि मोचितानि ग्रहीतुं वेदविद्वद ॥75॥

4.27.s:
dehi dhautāni dhṛtvā ca kariṣyāmo vrataṃ vayam..
vastunā'nyena govinda vastūnāṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ kuru .. 76..
4.27.d:
देहि धौतानि धृत्वा च करिष्यामो व्रतं वयम्॥
वस्तुनाऽन्येन गोविन्द वस्तूनां भक्षणं कुरु ॥ 76॥

4.27.s:
etasminnantare tatra śrīdāmā vastrapuñjikām ..
darśayitvā ca tāḥ sarvā dūraṃ dudrāva tatpuraḥ .. 77 ..
4.27.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र श्रीदामा वस्त्रपुञ्जिकाम् ॥
दर्शयित्वा च ताः सर्वा दूरं दुद्राव तत्पुरः ॥ 77 ॥

4.27.s:
dṛṣṭvā savastraṃ gopālaṃ sarvāsāmīśvarī parā ..
sarvā vayasyāścāvavāca kopayuktā jalaplutā ..78..
4.27.d:
दृष्ट्वा सवस्त्रं गोपालं सर्वासामीश्वरी परा ॥
सर्वा वयस्याश्चाववाच कोपयुक्ता जलप्लुता ॥78॥

4.27.s:
śrīrādhikovāca ..
he suśīle śaśikale he candramukhi mādhavi ..
kadambamāle he kunti yamune sarvamaṅgale..79 ..
4.27.d:
श्रीराधिकोवाच ॥
हे सुशीले शशिकले हे चन्द्रमुखि माधवि ॥
कदम्बमाले हे कुन्ति यमुने सर्वमङ्गले॥79 ॥

4.27.s:
he padmamukhi sāvitri pārijāte ca jāhnavi..
sudhāmukhi śubhe padme he gauri he svayaṃprabhe .. 4.27.80 ..
4.27.d:
हे पद्ममुखि सावित्रि पारिजाते च जाह्नवि॥
सुधामुखि शुभे पद्मे हे गौरि हे स्वयंप्रभे ॥ 4.27.80 ॥

4.27.s:
kālike kamale durge he sarasvati bhārati ..
apūrṇe rati he gaṃge cāmbike sati sundari .. 81 ..
4.27.d:
कालिके कमले दुर्गे हे सरस्वति भारति ॥
अपूर्णे रति हे गंगे चाम्बिके सति सुन्दरि ॥ 81 ॥

4.27.s:
kṛṣṇapriye madhumati campe candananandini ..
yūyaṃ sarvāḥ samutthāya baddhvā''nayata ballavam ..82..
4.27.d:
कृष्णप्रिये मधुमति चम्पे चन्दननन्दिनि ॥
यूयं सर्वाः समुत्थाय बद्ध्वा'ऽनयत बल्लवम् ॥82॥

4.27.s:
sarvā rādhājñayā tūrṇaṃ samutthāya jalātkrudhā ..
prajagmurgopikā nagnā yonimācchādya pāṇinā .. 83 ..
4.27.d:
सर्वा राधाज्ञया तूर्णं समुत्थाय जलात्क्रुधा ॥
प्रजग्मुर्गोपिका नग्ना योनिमाच्छाद्य पाणिना ॥ 83 ॥

4.27.s:
etāsāṃ sahacāriṇyo gopyastūrṇaṃ sahasraśaḥ ..
prajagmustena rūpeṇa kopādāraktalocanāḥ .. 84 ..
4.27.d:
एतासां सहचारिण्यो गोप्यस्तूर्णं सहस्रशः ॥
प्रजग्मुस्तेन रूपेण कोपादारक्तलोचनाः ॥ 84 ॥

4.27.s:
vegena dudruvuḥ sarvāḥ śrīdāmānaṃ ca bālikāḥ ..
vegena ca pradhāvantaṃ bibhrataṃ vastrapuṃjikām .. 85 ..
4.27.d:
वेगेन दुद्रुवुः सर्वाः श्रीदामानं च बालिकाः ॥
वेगेन च प्रधावन्तं बिभ्रतं वस्त्रपुंजिकाम् ॥ 85 ॥

4.27.s:
jagāma śīghraṃ śrīdāmā yatra gopāḥ sahāṃśukāḥ ..
javena dudruvurgopyastatpaścādbalasaṃyutāḥ .. 86 ..
4.27.d:
जगाम शीघ्रं श्रीदामा यत्र गोपाः सहांशुकाः ॥
जवेन दुद्रुवुर्गोप्यस्तत्पश्चाद्बलसंयुताः ॥ 86 ॥

4.27.s:
vastracorāṃśca gopāṃśca veṣṭayāmāsurāśu tāḥ ..
bhiyā pradudruvurbālā yatra kṛṣṇaḥ sahāṃśukaḥ .. 87 ..
4.27.d:
वस्त्रचोरांश्च गोपांश्च वेष्टयामासुराशु ताः ॥
भिया प्रदुद्रुवुर्बाला यत्र कृष्णः सहांशुकः ॥ 87 ॥
4.27.m: In fear the boys ran to where Kṛṣṇa was with the garments; / and quickly they chose the boys along with Śrīkṛṣṇa. / In fear of the cowherd maidens, the cowherds gave the garments to Mādhava. / Mādhava placed them on bough after bough of the tree; / the kadamba tree shone resplendent with the many kinds of clothes. / Having placed all the bundles of garments on the boughs, / Kṛṣṇa spoke words full of mockery to the cowherd maidens: / Śrīkṛṣṇa said: / "O naked cowherd maidens, what will you do now? / In order to make your petition for the clothes, quickly make a cupped-hand gesture! / Go and tell your mistress, Rādhikā: / let her make a petition for the clothes quickly with cupped hands! / Otherwise, I will not give the garments to you. / What can your mistress Rādhā do to me now? / And what can that goddess worshiped in your vow do to me? / Tell all of this just so to Rādhikā!" / Hearing Śrīkṛṣṇa's words, all those cowherd maidens, / casting sidelong glances, went into Rādhikā's presence. / Going there, they reported what Hari himself had said. / Hearing it, Rādhā laughed and was overcome with longing. / Hearing their words, her body bristling with horripilation, / the virtuous woman did not go to Hari's place out of modest shame, smiling. / Adopting a yogic posture in the water, she meditated on Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet, / worshiped by Brahmā, Īśa, Ananta, and Dharma, granting the highest desires. / Remembering again and again his lotus feet, her eyes filled with tears, / she praised the highest, attributeless Lord of her life with an overflow of devotion: / Rādhikā said: / "O Lord of Goloka, Lord of the gopīs, my Lord, beloved of my life, / O friend of the wretched, Lord of the wretched, Lord of all, praise be to you! / Lord of cowherds, Lord of herds of cattle, delight of Yaśodā!

4.27.s:
śrīkṛṣṇasahitānbālānvarayāmāsurāśu ca ..
gopikānāṃ bhiyā gopā dadurvastrāṇi mādhavam .. 88 ..
4.27.d:
श्रीकृष्णसहितान्बालान्वरयामासुराशु च ॥
गोपिकानां भिया गोपा ददुर्वस्त्राणि माधवम् ॥ 88 ॥

4.27.s:
mādhavaḥ sthāpayāmāsa skandhe skandhe tarostathā..
kadambavṛkṣaḥ śuśubhe vastrairnānāvidhairapi ..89 ..
4.27.d:
माधवः स्थापयामास स्कन्धे स्कन्धे तरोस्तथा॥
कदम्बवृक्षः शुशुभे वस्त्रैर्नानाविधैरपि ॥89 ॥

4.27.s:
vastrāṇāṃ puṃjikāḥ sarvāḥ skandheṣu vinidhāya ca ..
uvāca gopikāḥ kṛṣṇaḥ parihāsaparaṃ vacaḥ .. 4.27.90 ..
4.27.d:
वस्त्राणां पुंजिकाः सर्वाः स्कन्धेषु विनिधाय च ॥
उवाच गोपिकाः कृष्णः परिहासपरं वचः ॥ 4.27.90 ॥

4.27.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
bho bho gopālikā nagnā idānīṃ kiṃ kariṣyatha ..
vastrayāñcāṃ prakartuṃ ca kurutāśu puṭāñjalim .. 91 ..
4.27.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
भो भो गोपालिका नग्ना इदानीं किं करिष्यथ ॥
वस्त्रयाञ्चां प्रकर्तुं च कुरुताशु पुटाञ्जलिम् ॥ 91 ॥

4.27.s:
gatvā vadata yuṣmākamīśvarīmatha rādhikām ..
karotu śīghraṃ vastrāṇāṃ yāñcāṃ kṛtvā puṭāñjalim ..92..
4.27.d:
गत्वा वदत युष्माकमीश्वरीमथ राधिकाम् ॥
करोतु शीघ्रं वस्त्राणां याञ्चां कृत्वा पुटाञ्जलिम् ॥92॥

4.27.s:
anyathā'haṃ na dāsyāmi yuṣmabhyamaṃśukāni ca ..
yuṣmākamīśvarī rādhā kiṃ kariṣyati me'dhunā ..93..
4.27.d:
अन्यथाऽहं न दास्यामि युष्मभ्यमंशुकानि च ॥
युष्माकमीश्वरी राधा किं करिष्यति मेऽधुना ॥93॥

4.27.s:
vratārādhyā ca yā devī sā vā me kiṃ kariṣyati..
ityevaṃ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ brūta yūyaṃ ca rādhikām .. 94 ..
4.27.d:
व्रताराध्या च या देवी सा वा मे किं करिष्यति॥
इत्येवं कथितं सर्वं ब्रूत यूयं च राधिकाम् ॥ 94 ॥

4.27.s:
śrīkṛṣṇavacanaṃ śrutvā tāḥ sarvā gopakanyakāḥ ..
vīkṣya locanakoṇena prajagmū rādhikāntikam .. 95 ..
4.27.d:
श्रीकृष्णवचनं श्रुत्वा ताः सर्वा गोपकन्यकाः ॥
वीक्ष्य लोचनकोणेन प्रजग्मू राधिकान्तिकम् ॥ 95 ॥

4.27.s:
cakrurnivedanaṃ gatvā yaduvāca hariḥ svayam ..
śrutvā jahāsa sā rādhā babhūva kāmapīḍitā .. 96 ..
4.27.d:
चक्रुर्निवेदनं गत्वा यदुवाच हरिः स्वयम् ॥
श्रुत्वा जहास सा राधा बभूव कामपीडिता ॥ 96 ॥

4.27.s:
śrutvā tāsāṃ ca vacanaṃ pulakāñcitavigrahā ..
na jagāma hareḥ sthānaṃ vrīḍayā sasmitā satī ..97..
4.27.d:
श्रुत्वा तासां च वचनं पुलकाञ्चितविग्रहा ॥
न जगाम हरेः स्थानं व्रीडया सस्मिता सती ॥97॥

4.27.s:
jale yogāsanaṃ kṛtvā dadhyau kṛṣṇapadāmbujam ..
brahmeśānantadharmāṇāṃ vandyamīpsitadaṃ param .. 98 ..
4.27.d:
जले योगासनं कृत्वा दध्यौ कृष्णपदाम्बुजम् ॥
ब्रह्मेशानन्तधर्माणां वन्द्यमीप्सितदं परम् ॥ 98 ॥

4.27.s:
smāraṃsmāraṃ padāmbhojaṃ sā'śrusaṃpūrṇalocanā ..
bhāvātirekātprāṇeśaṃ tuṣṭāva nirguṇaṃ param .. 99 ..
4.27.d:
स्मारंस्मारं पदाम्भोजं साऽश्रुसंपूर्णलोचना ॥
भावातिरेकात्प्राणेशं तुष्टाव निर्गुणं परम् ॥ 99 ॥

4.27.s:
.. rādhikovāca .. ..
golokanātha gopīśa madīśa prāṇavallabha ..
he dīnabandho dīneśa sarveśvara namo'stu te .. 4.27.100 ..
4.27.d:
॥ राधिकोवाच ॥ ॥
गोलोकनाथ गोपीश मदीश प्राणवल्लभ ॥
हे दीनबन्धो दीनेश सर्वेश्वर नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 4.27.100 ॥

4.27.s:
gopeśa gosamūheśa yaśodānandavardhana ..
nandātmaja sadānanda nityānanda namo'stu te .. 101 ..
4.27.d:
गोपेश गोसमूहेश यशोदानन्दवर्धन ॥
नन्दात्मज सदानन्द नित्यानन्द नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 101 ॥

4.27.s:
śatamanyormanyubhagna brahmadarpavināśaka..
kālīyadamana prāṇanātha kṛṣṇa namo'stu te.. 102 ..
4.27.d:
शतमन्योर्मन्युभग्न ब्रह्मदर्पविनाशक॥
कालीयदमन प्राणनाथ कृष्ण नमोऽस्तु ते॥ 102 ॥

4.27.s:
śivānanteśa brahmeśa brāhmaṇeśa parātpara ..
brahmasvarūpa brahmajña brahmabīja namo'stu te ..103..
4.27.d:
शिवानन्तेश ब्रह्मेश ब्राह्मणेश परात्पर ॥
ब्रह्मस्वरूप ब्रह्मज्ञ ब्रह्मबीज नमोऽस्तु ते ॥103॥

4.27.s:
carācaratarorbīja guṇātīta guṇātmaka ..
guṇabīja guṇādhāra guṇeśvara namo'stu te ..104..
4.27.d:
चराचरतरोर्बीज गुणातीत गुणात्मक ॥
गुणबीज गुणाधार गुणेश्वर नमोऽस्तु ते ॥104॥

4.27.s:
aṇimādikasiddhīśa siddheḥ siddhisvarūpaka ..
tapastapasviṃstapasā bījarūpa namo'stu te .. 105 ..
4.27.d:
अणिमादिकसिद्धीश सिद्धेः सिद्धिस्वरूपक ॥
तपस्तपस्विंस्तपसा बीजरूप नमोऽस्तु ते ॥ 105 ॥

4.27.s:
yadanirvacanīyaṃ ca vastu nirvacanīyakam ..
tatsvarūpa tayorbījaṃ sarvabīja namo'stu te ..106..
4.27.d:
यदनिर्वचनीयं च वस्तु निर्वचनीयकम् ॥
तत्स्वरूप तयोर्बीजं सर्वबीज नमोऽस्तु ते ॥106॥

4.27.s:
ahaṃ sarasvatī lakṣmīrdurgā gaṅgā śrutiprasūḥ ..
yasya pādārcanānnityaṃ pūjyā tasmai namonamaḥ .. .. 107 ..
4.27.d:
अहं सरस्वती लक्ष्मीर्दुर्गा गङ्गा श्रुतिप्रसूः ॥
यस्य पादार्चनान्नित्यं पूज्या तस्मै नमोनमः ॥ ॥ 107 ॥

4.27.s:
sparśane yasya bhṛtyānāṃ dhyānena ca divāniśam ..
pavitrāṇi ca tīrthāni tasmai bhagavate namaḥ .. 108 ..
4.27.d:
स्पर्शने यस्य भृत्यानां ध्यानेन च दिवानिशम् ॥
पवित्राणि च तीर्थानि तस्मै भगवते नमः ॥ 108 ॥

4.27.s:
ityevamuktvā sā devī jale saṃnyasya vigraham ..
manaḥ prāṇāṃśca śrīkṛṣṇe tasthau sthāṇusamā satī .. 109 ..
4.27.d:
इत्येवमुक्त्वा सा देवी जले संन्यस्य विग्रहम् ॥
मनः प्राणांश्च श्रीकृष्णे तस्थौ स्थाणुसमा सती ॥ 109 ॥

4.27.s:
rādhākṛtaṃ hareḥ stotraṃ trisandhyaṃ yaḥ paṭhennaraḥ ..
haribhaktiṃ ca dāsyaṃ ca labhedrādhāgatiṃ dhruvam .. 4.27.110 ..
4.27.d:
राधाकृतं हरेः स्तोत्रं त्रिसन्ध्यं यः पठेन्नरः ॥
हरिभक्तिं च दास्यं च लभेद्राधागतिं ध्रुवम् ॥ 4.27.110 ॥

4.27.s:
vipattau yaḥ paṭhedbhaktyā sadyaḥ saṃpattimāpnuyāt ..
cirakālagataṃ dravyaṃ hṛtaṃ naṣṭaṃ ca labhyate ..111..
4.27.d:
विपत्तौ यः पठेद्भक्त्या सद्यः संपत्तिमाप्नुयात् ॥
चिरकालगतं द्रव्यं हृतं नष्टं च लभ्यते ॥111॥

4.27.s:
vastuvṛddhirbhavettasya prasannaṃ mānasaṃ param ..
cintāgrastaḥ paṭhedbhaktyā parāṃ nirvṛtimāpnuyāt ..112..
4.27.d:
वस्तुवृद्धिर्भवेत्तस्य प्रसन्नं मानसं परम् ॥
चिन्ताग्रस्तः पठेद्भक्त्या परां निर्वृतिमाप्नुयात् ॥112॥

4.27.s:
patibhede putrabhede mitrabhede ca saṃkaṭe ..
māsaṃ bhaktyā yadi paṭhetsadyaḥ saṃdarśanaṃ labhet .. 113 ..
4.27.d:
पतिभेदे पुत्रभेदे मित्रभेदे च संकटे ॥
मासं भक्त्या यदि पठेत्सद्यः संदर्शनं लभेत् ॥ 113 ॥

4.27.s:
bhaktyā kumārī stotraṃ ca śṛṇuyādvatsaraṃ yadi ..
śrīkṛṣṇasadṛśaṃ kāntaṃ guṇavantaṃ labheddhruvam ..114..
4.27.d:
भक्त्या कुमारी स्तोत्रं च शृणुयाद्वत्सरं यदि ॥
श्रीकृष्णसदृशं कान्तं गुणवन्तं लभेद्ध्रुवम् ॥114॥

4.27.s:
iti śrībrahmavaivarte śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍe rādhākṛtaṃ śrīkṛṣṇa stotram ..
jalasthā rādhikā dhyātvā śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇāmbujam ..
stutvaivaṃ cakṣurunmīlya dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇamayaṃ jagat .. 115 ..
4.27.d:
इति श्रीब्रह्मवैवर्ते श्रीकृष्णजन्मखण्डे राधाकृतं श्रीकृष्ण स्तोत्रम् ॥
जलस्था राधिका ध्यात्वा श्रीकृष्णचरणाम्बुजम् ॥
स्तुत्वैवं चक्षुरुन्मील्य दृष्ट्वा कृष्णमयं जगत् ॥ 115 ॥
4.27.m: Son of Nanda, eternal bliss, perpetual bliss, praise be to you! / Destroyer of Indra's fury, destroyer of Brahmā's pride, / subduer of Kāliya, Lord of life, Kṛṣṇa, praise be to you! / Lord of Śiva, Ananta, and Brahmā, Lord of the brāhmaṇas, higher than the highest, / embodiment of Brahman, knower of Brahman, seed of Brahman, praise be to you! / Seed of the tree of the moving and unmoving, beyond the gunas, consisting of the gunas, / seed of the gunas, receptacle of the gunas, master of the gunas, praise be to you! / Master of the yogic perfections such as anima, the essence of perfection itself, / penance, the ascetic, the seed-form of penance, praise be to you! / That which is ineffable and that which is expressible, / the nature of both, the seed of both, seed of all, praise be to you! / By daily worshiping whose feet I, Sarasvatī, Lakṣmī, / Durgā, Gaṅgā, and the mother of the Vedas are worshiped—praise, praise to him! / By touching whose servants and by meditating [on him] day and night / the holy pilgrimage sites become pure—praise to that Blessed One!" / Having spoken thus, the virtuous goddess, resting her body in the water, / and fixing her mind and life-breath on Śrīkṛṣṇa, remained still as a pillar. / Whichever man recites at the three junctures of the day this hymn of praise to Hari composed by Rādhā / surely attains devotion to Hari, servitorship, and the destination of Rādhā. / Whoever recites it with devotion in times of distress swiftly obtains prosperity; / goods long gone, stolen, or lost are recovered. / His possessions increase and his mind becomes exceedingly serene; / if stricken with worry, one who recites it with devotion attains supreme peace. / In alienation from a husband, a son, or a friend, and in perilous straits, / if one recites it with devotion for a month, one immediately secures an encounter. / If a maiden hears this hymn of praise with devotion for a year, / she surely gains a virtuous husband equal to Śrīkṛṣṇa. / Thus ends the hymn of praise to Śrīkṛṣṇa composed by Rādhā in the Śrīkṛṣṇajanmakhaṇḍa of the glorious Brahmavaivartapurāṇa.

4.27.s:
dadarśa yamunātīraṃ vastradravyamayaṃ mune ..
dṛṣṭvā tandrā'thavā svapnamiti mene ca rādhikā ..116..
4.27.d:
ददर्श यमुनातीरं वस्त्रद्रव्यमयं मुने ॥
दृष्ट्वा तन्द्राऽथवा स्वप्नमिति मेने च राधिका ॥116॥

4.27.s:
yatra sthāne yadādhāre yaddravyaṃ saṃsthitaṃ purā ..
vastraiśca sahitaṃ sarvaṃ tatprāpurgopakanyakāḥ .. 117 ..
4.27.d:
यत्र स्थाने यदाधारे यद्द्रव्यं संस्थितं पुरा ॥
वस्त्रैश्च सहितं सर्वं तत्प्रापुर्गोपकन्यकाः ॥ 117 ॥

4.27.s:
jalādutthāya tāḥ sarvā vrataṃ kṛtvā manīṣitam ..
saṃprāpya ca varaṃ devyastā sarvāḥ svālayaṃ yayuḥ .. 118 ..
4.27.d:
जलादुत्थाय ताः सर्वा व्रतं कृत्वा मनीषितम् ॥
संप्राप्य च वरं देव्यस्ता सर्वाः स्वालयं ययुः ॥ 118 ॥

4.27.s:
nārada uvāca ..
vratasya kiṃ vidhānaṃ ca kiṃ nāma kiṃ phalaṃ prabho ..
kāni dravyāṇi deyāni kā deyā tatra dakṣiṇā .. 119 ..
4.27.d:
नारद उवाच ॥
व्रतस्य किं विधानं च किं नाम किं फलं प्रभो ॥
कानि द्रव्याणि देयानि का देया तत्र दक्षिणा ॥ 119 ॥

4.27.s:
vratānte kiṃ rahasyaṃ ca babhūva sumanoharam ..
vyāsaṃ kṛtvā mahābhāga vada nārāyaṇīṃ kathām .. .. 4.27.120 ..
4.27.d:
व्रतान्ते किं रहस्यं च बभूव सुमनोहरम् ॥
व्यासं कृत्वा महाभाग वद नारायणीं कथाम् ॥ ॥ 4.27.120 ॥

4.27.s:
sūta uvāca ..
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā prahasya munipuṃgavaḥ ..
kathāṃ kathitumārebhe kavīndrāṇāṃ gurorguruḥ .. 121 ..
4.27.d:
सूत उवाच ॥
नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रहस्य मुनिपुंगवः ॥
कथां कथितुमारेभे कवीन्द्राणां गुरोर्गुरुः ॥ 121 ॥

4.27.s:
nārāyaṇa uvāca ..
sarvaṃ vratavidhānaṃ ca matto vatsa niśāmaya ..
khyātaṃ gaurīvrataṃ nāma mārge māsi kṛtaṃ striyā .. .. 122 ..
4.27.d:
नारायण उवाच ॥
सर्वं व्रतविधानं च मत्तो वत्स निशामय ॥
ख्यातं गौरीव्रतं नाम मार्गे मासि कृतं स्त्रिया ॥ ॥ 122 ॥

4.27.s:
puṃsāṃ ca dharmakāmārthamokṣadaṃ kṛṣṇabhaktidam..
deśabhede prasiddhaṃ ca vrataṃ paurvāparaṃ smṛtam ..123 ..
4.27.d:
पुंसां च धर्मकामार्थमोक्षदं कृष्णभक्तिदम्॥
देशभेदे प्रसिद्धं च व्रतं पौर्वापरं स्मृतम् ॥123 ॥

4.27.s:
kāmadaṃ kāmukānāṃ ca phalaṃ kāntanimittakam ..
upoṣya pūrvadivase vastraṃ prakṣālya saṃyatā .. 124 ..
4.27.d:
कामदं कामुकानां च फलं कान्तनिमित्तकम् ॥
उपोष्य पूर्वदिवसे वस्त्रं प्रक्षाल्य संयता ॥ 124 ॥

4.27.s:
prātaśca mārgasaṃkrāntyāṃ bhaktyā gatvā sarittaṭam ..
dhṛtvā dhaute ca snātvā ca nānādravyeṇa kanyakā .. 125..
4.27.d:
प्रातश्च मार्गसंक्रान्त्यां भक्त्या गत्वा सरित्तटम् ॥
धृत्वा धौते च स्नात्वा च नानाद्रव्येण कन्यका ॥ 125॥

4.27.s:
devaṣaṭkaṃ ca saṃpūjya kṛtvā cāvāhanaṃ ghaṭe ..
gaṇeśaṃ ca dineśaṃ ca vahniṃ nārāyaṇaṃ śivam .. 126 ..
4.27.d:
देवषट्कं च संपूज्य कृत्वा चावाहनं घटे ॥
गणेशं च दिनेशं च वह्निं नारायणं शिवम् ॥ 126 ॥

4.27.s:
durgāṃ paṃcopacāraiśca saṃpūjya vratamārabhet ..
ghaṭādhaḥ piṇḍikāṃ kṛtvā caturasrāṃ suvistṛtām ..
candanāgurukastūrīkuṅkumaiśca susaṃskṛtām .. 127..
4.27.d:
दुर्गां पंचोपचारैश्च संपूज्य व्रतमारभेत् ॥
घटाधः पिण्डिकां कृत्वा चतुरस्रां सुविस्तृताम् ॥
चन्दनागुरुकस्तूरीकुङ्कुमैश्च सुसंस्कृताम् ॥ 127॥
4.27.m:
Standing in the water, Rādhikā meditated upon Lord Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet; / having thus praised him, she opened her eyes and saw the world full of Kṛṣṇa.
O sage, she saw the bank of the Yamunā full of their garments and belongings; / seeing it, Rādhikā wondered whether it was a stupor or a dream.
Whatever article had earlier been placed in whatever spot and container, / the cowherd maidens found it all, together with their garments.
Rising from the water, they all completed the vow they had desired; / having received the boon of the goddess, they all went to their respective homes.
Nārada said: / What are the rules of this vow, what is its name, and what is its fruit, O Lord? / What articles should be offered, and what dakṣiṇā should be given there?
What delightful secret occurred at the conclusion of the vow? / Explain it in detail, O fortunate one; tell the sacred story of Nārāyaṇa.
Sūta said: / Hearing the words of Nārada, that bull among sages, / the guru of the greatest poets, smiled and began to tell the story.
Nārāyaṇa said: / Listen to all the rules of the vow from me, my child: / it is famous as the Gaurīvrata, performed by a woman in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa.
To men it grants dharma, kāma, artha, and mokṣa, and bestows devotion to Kṛṣṇa; / renowned in different regions, it is remembered as ancient and unbroken.
It grants the desires of lovers, yielding the fruit of gaining a husband. / Having fasted on the preceding day and washed her garment, self-restrained,
and on the morning of the Mārga-saṃkrānti having gone with devotion to the riverbank, / putting on clean clothes and bathing, the maiden, with various offerings,
should worship the six deities, having invoked them into a water-pot: / Gaṇeśa, the Sun, Fire, Nārāyaṇa, Śiva,
and Durgā, worshipping them with the five articles, she should begin the vow. / Making a large square altar beneath the pot, / adorned with sandalwood, agallochum, musk, and saffron,

4.27.s:
nirmāya bālukānāṃ ca durgāṃ daśabhujāṃ parām ..
dhṛtvā kapāle sindūraṃ tadadhaścandanendukam ..128..
4.27.d:
निर्माय बालुकानां च दुर्गां दशभुजां पराम् ॥
धृत्वा कपाले सिन्दूरं तदधश्चन्दनेन्दुकम् ॥128॥
4.27.m:
and fashioning out of sand the supreme ten-armed Durgā, / applying vermilion to her forehead and beneath it a crescent of sandalwood,
